tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas bdag nyid ky-i rnam thar nges par brjod pa'i deb gter shin tu zhib mo ma bcos lhug pa'i rtogs brjod ces bya ba'i smad cha bzhugs/

oṃ a tha/ legs lam ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gzhi las brtsams te cung zad brjod par bya'o/ / de la shing mo yos kyi lo shar ba na/ dge mtshan gyi ltas du ma dang bcas hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes bcu gcig nyi ma me bzhi'i 'grub sbyor 'dzom pa la gnas gzhi gsar 'debs byed par 'dod pas/ bla brang dam chos gling nas yongs dus/ sgo drung du mtshams len brgyad chu bum pa khengs pa thogs nas dga' ba la dga' ba la zer ba sogs lam la phrad pa rnams kyang tshig bkra dang lam bkra shin tu legs pa dang bcas/ nyi ma shar ba na rdzong mdo'i mdun gyi sa gzhi khri stegs lta bu 'dir sleb/ sa chog gi sa brtag bslang sbyang bzung rgyas par byas/ sa bzung ba'i skabs/ nam mkha' gang ba sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' mngon sum du bzhugs nges snyam pa yang byung*/ gtor ma rgya cher gtong ba'i skabs/ da lta'i mgon khang u tsa la'i mtho dman 'di tsam gyi tshad du/ chos skyong mgon po lcam dral gzhi bdag dang bcas pa rnams 'khor a tsa ra dang*/ mon pa rta lug g.yag khyi mang po dang bcas rol mo'i sgra 'ur 'ur chem chem byon pa'i rnam pa gsal byung*/ de nas re zhig zla smad de la rdo gsog ces byas/ rang re de bar du rgyal rtse bla ma'i drung dang*/ chos rje ye shes rgya mtsho ba dang*/ dkon mchog legs 'dzin pa sogs la chos sna 'ga' re yang bshad/ yang hor zla gsum pa'i tshes brgyad gza' tshes dga' ba la/ gtsug lag khang gi thig 'debs shing 'gram 'dru ba'i phyir/ slar sa chog dngos gzhi rgyas pa de/ dpal 'jigs med 'byung gnas sbas pa'i bzhed pa dkyil chog rdo rje 'phreng ba las ji skad 'byung ba bzhin du bsgrubs/ sngar sa bslang ba'i dus dang 'di gnyis kar du nam mkha' la 'ja' 'od dkyus ma ma yin pa dang*/ me tog gi char 'bab pa dang*/ shar phyogs nas glo bur du grwa pa mang dag re sleb pa byung*/ 'di gnyis ka la dga' ston gyi tshul du/

rang re'i grwa pa thams cad kyis kyang byon te/ mang ja tsha ra spyi 'bul gyi rnam grangs re byas/ snga sor rang bzhin la yul ljongs phu mda' 'di kun grog ma mang ba zhig yin/ sa chog gi nyin mo 'di skabs kyang grog ma sogs srogs chags mang ba 'dug kyang*/ mi ring ba nas dgon pa'i sa gzhi nye skor dang bcas pa thams cad la/ da lta'i bar du grog ma ye med cing*/ srog chags gzhan yang nyung ngu song*/ gzhi bdag la sogs pas sa byin pa'i rtags mngon sum lags mod/ sngar gyi sa cha'i ming de bsgyur te/ rtag brtan dam pa'i chos kyi gling nges don dga' ba'i tshal du thog ma nyid nas ming btags/ snga sor hor zla gnyis pa'i nang du/ chos rje gnyis sogs rang re'i grwa pa sum brgya skor la ri khrod chen po'i 'du khang du/ rdo rje 'phreng ba'i dbang bskur ba zhag nyer brgyad pa zhig byas/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor rdul tshon dang*/ gzhan rnams ras bris yin/ nag pa'i zla ba la dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i sgrub mchod gsar pa btsugs shing*/ chos rje ye shes rgya mtsho bas shar sgo slob dpon mdzad/ lho sgo'i slob dpon ni rgyal rtse bla ma'i drung gis mdzad pa yin na'ang*/ shin tu sku khams ltems te dngos gzhi la phebs ma thug sgrub mchod kyi mthar/ tshogs mchod nyer mkho gsar pa sgrigs pa de'i steng nas tshogs 'khor yang byas/ dus 'khor gyi tshogs mchod mdzad pa'i srol bar skabs nas 'chad 'duganag pa'i bco lnga sgrub mchod dngos gzhi'i nyin/ sde pa gzhung gi sa nas/ shing bzo rdo bzo gtos che ba rdzong bar mdzad pa tsho yang 'byor/ ri bo che nas rje 'gyur med sku gshegs pa'i bsngo rten thugs dam gsal 'debs skyel mkhan yang skabs 'dir sleb/ de rjes mi ring bar phyogs kyi chos zhu mkhan kun yang phyogs phyogs su thegs song*/ nged kyi rtag brtan la skabs skabs su blta ba la yang 'gro dgos pa dang*/

g.yas g.yon gyi ri rtse sa gnad che sa rnams su zla phyed zla phyed la gtor ma gtong bar phyin/ gzhan dpyid la dbyar btags te phal cher skyid phug tu mtshams bsdams te bsdad/ zla ba bzhi pa'i gnam gang la nyi ma gza' 'dzin zhig byung skabs/ da lta'i 'bras spungs kyi thad kyi brag rtse 'di nas gtor ma chen po zhig btang bas/ chos skyong gi rnam 'phrul mi mang po dang bya rog ches che ba mang po nged rnams yar lung dang*/ chu sgo gzhung na las ka chen po mang po sgrub rgyu yod zer nas/ shar phyogs kyi nam mkha' la yol gyis song*/ phyis de ngor dang ras chung phug pa lta bar 'duga'adi lo byang ngam ring du ni zhabs drung rang gi bka' bkod bsgyur ba la/ chu 'og pa sogs chos sde 'gas da nas rje kun dga' grol mchog gi bstod pa'i rigs rnams tshogs su ma 'don zhig ces dril sgrog par mdzad gda'o/ seng seng la gsang 'dus 'phags skor gyi sgrub dkyil dang 'khor lo bde mchog lu dril nag gsum gyi sgrub dkyil rnams brtsams/ de yang 'phags skor 'di la sngar chog rgyas pa gtso bor ston pa'i yig cha kho na mang bar 'dug pa las 'dir don tshang zhing 'khyer bde bar byas/ lū hi pa'i sgrub thabs la rgya bod gnyis char du rtsa rkyang gi lugs dang 'grel ba'i lugs zhes so sor grags shing*/ rtsa rkyang la yang kha skong can gyi lugs dang*/ kha skong med pa gnyis yod/ kha skong med pa'i srol 'dzin pa nyung*/ kha skong can la'ang mi 'dra ba shin tu mang bar 'duga'agrel pa'i lugs 'di la pradz+nyā rak+ṣi ta'i lugs su grags/ grags pa de la brten nas 'di tshogs bshad yin pa dang*/ 'di la mi 'thad pa dang mi legs pa yod tshul byed mkhan bar skabs su yang cung zad byung zhing*/ phyis ngor pa'i srol 'dzin rnams kyis rgya cher sgrags so/ / de ni khungs mchod pa'i thal song chen po yin te/ pradz+nyā rak+ṣi ta'i chos bzhi zhes bya ba ni/

khong nyid kyis brtsams pa ma yin te/ grub thob chen po lwa ba pas mdzad pa'i 'grel pa na/ chabs cig tu yod pa de pradz+nyā rak+ṣi tas sde tshan bzhir bcad de so sor byas pas de ltar grags pa tsam ma gtogs/ tshig don la phri bsnan cung zad kyang med na pradz+nyā rak+ti ta 'gog par 'dod pas/ grub pa'i dbang phyug lwa ba pa la sdig sogs par zad do/ / de bas na nā ro pa'i man ngag yin min la rag ma lus kyi/ nā ro pa bas kyang chas che zhing*/ ches snga rol du byon par lū hi pa nyid kyi rjes mi ring ba kho nar byung ba lwa ba pa'i lugs 'di nyid ngo mtshar che bas de dang mthun par byas/ dkyil chog ni dā ri ka chung ba'i lugs 'di dang bla ma gong ma rnams kyi 'di yang mthun par 'dug pas de'i lugs dang*/ dril bu las dkyil gyi dbang chog la yang*/ kha bskong rgyas bsdus gnyis 'dug pas/ bsdus pa'i lugs 'di legs par shes nas de bzhin sbyar/ nag po lugs kyi sgrub thabs la yang gzhung dang mthun par gcos dgos pa cung zad snang la/ dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga la sngar gzhung don ji lta ba bzhin du longs pa ched ma byung bar snang bas/ grub chen nag po spyod pa'i dgongs pa ji lta ba bzhin du gnas pa 'di sbyar ro/ / 'di bris zin pa'i nub mo rmi lam du/ spang ljongs nyams dga' ba me tog du mas brgyan pa cig na phar phyin pas/ ji zhig ltar nas dur khrod chen po 'jigs su rung ba cig tu sleb/ de'i dbus na lha khang cig 'dug pa der zhugs de phyin pas/ rgya gar gyi ā tsar+ya mang po re re bzhin pu ti 'dzings pa re thogs nas sgrig gin 'dugaso sor 'grig tsa na po ti gcig tu song*/ kha phye nas bltas pas 'khor lo sdom pa'i dbang chog rgyas pa yin zer gcig 'dugade nas a tsa ra de rnams kyis maṇ+ḍal ljang khu chen po zhig byas/ tshes bcu'i cho ga byed rgyu yin zer bud med mang pos tshogs rdzas khyer nas byung*/

khong rnams cho ga byed kyi 'dugamaṇ+ḍal gyi dkyil du 'od sngon po khyil le ba zhig byung*/ de la brtags pas de'i dkyil na 'khor lo sdom pa zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa/ zhal thams cad shin tu khro nyams che zhing*/ yas kyi mche ba yas la log pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs de ral pa kham ser/ a tsa ra 'ga' zhig gi ral cog ltar/ sgor sgor po la rdo rje'i 'phreng ba rgya mdud ris su bcings ba gcig 'dugasku de je che je cher song nas mi tshad tsam du song ba la gnyid sad do/ / de la po ti 'dzings pa bsgrigs pas 'grig pa ni/ dkyil chog gi go rim sngar gyi bla mas mdzad pa rnams 'khrugs pa la 'dir dgongs don dang mthun par 'grig zer ba'i brda ru 'dug/ spang ljongs dang dur khrod du phyin pa ni/ ri bo tshang tshing sman ljongs dang*/ zhes dkyil 'khor 'bri ba'i gnas bstan par 'dug pas/ dbang bskur gyis shig pa'i brda don yin pa 'dra snyam pa shar/ skabs der snga sor gnyer ba kun dga' bkra shis la gtam smras pa de 'dzam thang du sleb 'dug pas/ 'dzam thang spyi sa dang bla ma ka bzhi pa'i yi ge 'byor zhing*/ re zhing sku skye'i gnas tshul 'dri bar byung ba yin/ de'i don spyi babs sngar bzhin dang*/ sgos su yang nga ni dgung lo yang bgres shing bon la bag chags brtas pas/ de phyogs su phan thogs rang zhig dka' ba'i tshul bsrings kyang*/ nged la 'dod don sgrub rgyu cig yong ngam snyam pa'i dogs pa skyes nas mi nyan pa snang/ 'di skabs rtag brtan gyi lcags ri 'khor yug tu 'brel pa thog so do tsam dang*/ nyer mkho'i khang pa gnyis gsum dang gtso bor gtsug lag khang chen mo'i 'og thog khel ba yin/ skabs der 'du khang chen mo'i ka ba 'dzugs pa'i nyin/ nged rang gcig pu skyid phug na yod pa'i skabs/ mi nag po 'ga' dang*/ gyad stobs po che yin zer ba 'ga' re de ring las ka khag che ba yod/ sang nyin gtor ma cig kyang ster dgos zer nas song*/

dgongs mo kun dga' dpal bzang sogs khong tsho sleb byung ba la/ ka ba slong mkhan mang po song yod byas/ ga tsam tshugs dris dus seng g.yabs kyi ka ba gnyis ma lags pa'i/ ka ba sum cu so bzhi po thams cad tsha bzhes grol nas nyi ma phyed zur yan la tshugs 'dugahor zla drug pa'i tshes bcu gsum gyi nyin mo yin/ sang gtor ma bzang pa zhig kyang btang*/ de'i phyi nyin tshes bco lnga la 'du khang gi gdung thams cad snga dro nas nyi phyed yan la khel nas/ mtha'i lcam yul 'ga' shas la rgyug kyang thongs pa byung*/ thog lha'i tshul du grwa pa thams cad byon pa'i mang ja gdan bzhes sogs dga' ston dang*/ bzo bo rnams la ston mo'i skabs/ rma bya nas slob gnyer ba snga ma rnams kyang sleb pa sogs legs lam du byung*/ sgo khang gi gdung mdun ma chen mo de 'gel ba'i skabs/ sne phyogs gcig mar lhungs 'dug kyang*/ skyon gang yang ma byung zhing de 'phral mi gnyis kyis 'then thub/ 'di skabs tho rangs snga mo nas mi su yang ma langs pa la/ rdo rtsig pa 'dra ba'i phrog sgra chen po dang*/ shing gshog pa lta bu'i sgra sogs thams cad las ka la langs 'dug snyam pa la/ blta bar phyin du gang yang mi mthong ba de 'dra nub gcig nub gnyis min pa rgyun du byung*/ rdo ches che ba mang po byis pa bu mo chung chung 'dras skyel ba dang*/ cho 'phrul che ba la rdo chen mo mi gnyis gsum gyi 'degs dgos yang rdo'i spe'u mi gcig pa dang las khung mi gcig pa phan tshun du brjes pa yang mang du byung*/ thog ma 'ga' re la brkus pa yin nam snyam pa'i yid mi ches byung yang*/ phyis thams cad kyis cho 'phrul du nges shes rnyed/ lcags ri'i rgya sgo rnams bcug pa nas gzung ste/ phyi nang gi rten 'brel zhig yin pa 'dugade lta bu gsal bar ma byung*/ de skabs glo bur du sbrul dkar po gnyis shig da lta'i lho gling gi thang 'dir byung 'dug pas/

las rgyab pa gcig gis chu rong du bskyal 'dugade bzhag na gling khong du chu gcig rdol yong rgyur gda'/ de nas ston ser kha mkha' spyod bde ldan du mtshams zhag bdun tsam zhig byas/ rgyab ri sngon 'bor skyong gi rtse mor gtor ma gtong ba la phyin dus yar lam khams shin tu ma bde ba'i ngang nas sleb tsam byung*/ nang par gtor ma btang bas shin tu bzlogs che ba'i ltas shar/ rang re lo bco lnga pa'i dus kyi rkang lag gi rjes yin gyu'i khungs sa la sbas pa zhig yod pa'ang las byed tshos sa drus pas thon/ brag la'ang rjes yin snyam pa zhig byung ste ya mtshan pa dang bar chad gang yang min lags/ dam chos gling du rigs ldan lha khang gi logs bris rnams kyang grub cing dkyil thang drug bdun cig dang*/ gzhan zhing khams ma bdun tsam bzhengs pa yang mthar phyin/ don gnyer 'ga' zhig la rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi chos than thun bshad/ yi dam dang mkha' 'gro la gsol ba yang yang btab pas/ gnang ba'i mtshan ma byung nas dpyid kyi thig le'i ṭī ka de brtsams/ rtag brtan du yang ston de gtsang khang gi thog kyang khel zhing*/ rung khang gi 'og thog kyang legs par grub/ lcags ri nang gi mtha'i khang pa bcu lhag zhig gi 'og thog khel ba dang*/ lcags ri'i kha gso'i yang ci rigs pa/ lcog rnams la'ang mi sdod nyan pa dang*/ 'bras spung gi ma khang 'di yang rags rim grub pa sogs mdor na las byed pa nyung yang grub shin tu che ba zhig byung*/ 'di lo sde pa gzhung nas 'u lag brgya skor re zla ba gsum tsam gyi bar la gnang*/ de nas mi ring ba'i dus zhig la dbang mdor bstan gyi 'grel chen 'di phyi mtsham me ba'i khog nas brtsams pas zhag po dgu la grub byung*/ snga sor gnang bzhu ba'i don du gsol ba btab pa la yang ltas bzang ba cig byung*/ des na deng sang mang po zhig kha cig dpe bris bshus kha cig blo bzo tsam gyi sngags don 'chad pa las rang grag tsam yin par go

/ de rjes khra bo gling gi nang der sbyin bsreg che ba zhig kyang phul/ 'di skabs bsam 'grub rtse nas 'bod mi gnang don la/ kam tshang sgang pa dmangs 'di spyan 'dren zhabs tog rgya che ba mi mdzad pa'i thabs med pa la 'tshub 'gyur yang che bar yod 'dug pas rkyen sel gyi dbang sogs la 'phral du yong dgos pheb byung ba de mthun grwa pa rnams dang lhan cig rtag brtan du phyin/ da bzod las ka ma ran par grwa pa rnams der sdod par byas/ nged kyis rten 'brel du nges don rgya mtsho'i lung gi 'go tshugs tsam byas yongs dus/ lung nag rdzong zhol du srod gdong nag la sleb/ nang so thog gis gzhi len byung*/ de nas bsam rtser sleb dus sku mtsham pa tsam gnang 'dugasleb nyin nas gzung ste/ rkyen sel gyi dbang rjes gnang rnam grangs mang ba 'bul bzhin pa dang*/ lo gsar mdor bsdus zhig gnang ba'i dus dang thug pa'i dga' ston rgya che ba dang gzhan yang sku rim bgyis pa rnams dmigs su 'gro zhing legs par byung*/ de skabs chos rje shangs pa shākya bstan 'dzin pa'i drung paṇa chen shākya'i mtshan can gyi khri thog tu myur du 'byon rgyu'i thugs dges pa dang spro ba sags sags rang dang bcas/ de mthun gyi chos zhu yang nor lha'i rjes gnang mang po dgos gsung pa ltar byas/

khong pa dang brag dmar mkhan chen dang slob dpon bkra shis phun tshogs sogs dge bshes 'ga' shas la/ rdo rje bdag med ma'i byin rlabs byas pas/ de nub nas zhag gsum bzhi zhig shin tu na ba'i 'tshub tu mngon par byung*/ tshogs gtor dang bshags pa 'dra phul bas gragakhong rang bla ma slob dpon pa de rnams thugs nang shin tu ma dag par 'dug pas lan nam/ gang yin cha mi 'tshal/ gser mdog can grwa tshang chen mo'i slob dpon chos rje thog pa ba la gshed dmar gyi chos 'ga' re bshad/ li ma lha khang rags rim 'grig pa la bgegs sprod sogs kyang bsgrubs/ sku rim pa rnams 'tshogs sa'i 'du khang gsar bzhengs la rab gnas byas/ sde srid la mnal ltas 'tshub tsam cig byung 'dug pa/ ji ltar yin rtogs shig gsung bas/ sku dog yod pa'i ltas rang ni min pa 'dugagazhan gyis cho 'phrul ltas ngan 'dra bsgrubs pa'i rnam char 'dug pas/ de mthun gyi sku rim phul/ de rjes 'bod mi byung ba ltar/ nged kyis tshong 'dus su zhag gsum pa zhig bsdad/ la rgan rgyud 'dol byung du phyin zhag shas bsdad/ rkyen sel gyi chos bka' 'dra byas/ phyogs de sngar lugs kyi 'dzom cha chen po bag dro ba de ni mi gda'/ sku skye bcu bzhi'i zhal thang gsar bzhengs bzang po mdzad 'dug pa la rab gnas rgyas pa byas de nas bsam sdings su zhag po gsum pa zhig bsdad de/ tshud lam rgyan gong gi lha mo dpal ldan ma la zhu don zhig yod pas mjal/ mchod gtor bzab ma phul tshur yongs bas sngar thab 'dzin 'ong ba'i shul de kar snar thang pas thab 'dzin zhig byung*/ der mi 'tshogs che zhing*/ gang nas yongs cha med pa'i bud med gzi byin che ba gos dkar po gyon pa zhig kyang byung*/ mthong ni thams cad kyis mthong gin 'dug ste/ gang yin ngo shes pa ni gzhan mi 'dug go / byang chen du'ang zhag gsum bsdad/ sde pa bstan rgyal drung dang*/ sde pa ka bzhi'i drung gi sku skye rin po che dang bdag cag lhan cig gnas kyi klu sdings der zhag gcig bsdad/

rgya gan nas kyi yar lam rdzong la 'bod rtsis kyi bzhed yod pa la/ de skabs grabs ma grub par zhol gyi klu sdings der tsha bzhes cig byung*/ snga sor rdzong rtser phyin skabs dang*/ kha sing de'i mar lam gnyis kar la yang 'tshub tu mngon des shes pa byung zhing*/ de res ni stong pa nyid kyis zil gyis mnan pas cang ma byung*/ 'di skabs gong dkar du rje ngag dbang bzang po gshegs pa'i zhe dgu'i sgang gi rlung 'tshub chen mo'i ring yin/ nged dang chos 'brel ni med zhal 'dris kyang chen po med de/ bka' rgyud pa 'di ba mdzad sgo legs pas/ nged la'ang thugs dam gsal 'debs phran bu bskyal byung*/ sa skya pa'i zhal ngo 'di rnams rang gis rang la ka bsngo rten 'bul ba ma gtogs mi mdzad pa'i srol cig gda'o/ / de rjes 'gyangs chen med par rje 'jam grags pa zhu ba'i 'brug pa'i dbu che zhig yong 'dug pa'ang*/ gza' gdong thug gi rnam pas thegs 'dug pa'i gsal 'debs bsngo rten yang byung*/ khong de gnyis kar grongs pa'i rgyu rkyen de mgar ba rang gi mtshon chas bsad pa'i dpe ltar rgyu rkyen gcig pa cig yin par 'dug ste/ slob brgyud tshos go ni da dung ma go bar gda'/ snga sor dbyar dus de/ dar lung phyogs su klu gtor mang du btang ba dang*/ sbrul phyir bskyal ba de'i rten 'brel gyis/ da lta'i sgrub chu chu mig chen po 'di/ skabs 'di tsam brdol ba yin/ de nas rgyal gyi zla ba'i tshes bcu bzhi la jo nang gi dgun khrid kyang tshugs par byas/ rang re'i slob rigs gsang phur pa smad pa'i slob dpon rgyal mtshan 'od zer ba yang slong mo la skabs 'dir byung*/ smon thang mkhan chen pas se rib kyi grwa rgyun lnga ba zhig rdzong bar mdzad pa skabs 'dir sleb/ mchog dbang gong ma'i snga dro snar thang nas lcam drung yang 'khrid la 'byor ba yin/ dam po grol nas skra bcad mdzad/ dam po ma thebs kyi ring khrid kyi sngon 'gro'i skabs la rtag brtan dang jo nang gnyis su mtshan bsdod re mos byas/

gcig tu snga chos grol nas gcig tu dgongs chos 'dzugs par sogs/ nyin re bzhin gnyis kar du chos thun ma chag pa lcogs shing zor yang ba zhig byung*/ 'di'i sgang dang nag nya yan la grwa pa rnams la snying po'i mdo lnga'i bshad pa dang*/ dbang mdor bstan gyi bshad pa yongs rdzogs song*/ 'khrid gtor skabs/ yar rgyab nas lcam drung yang phebs shing de rjes mi ring ba na chos sgor zhugs/ khrid gtor grol ba'i nyin mo rang sde srid kyi bka' bkod dang bstun nas/ chos sde brag dmar ba'i grwa rgyun nyi shu rtsa bgrang pa zhig 'byor/ slar yang zla ba gnyis pa dang gsum pa'i mtshams nas/ rtag brtan gyis las ka btsugs shing*/ grwa pa rnams ri khrod chen por chos bar la byon/ nag nya grol nas rang res bsgrigs pa'i sgrub thabs rin chen 'byung gnas kyi steng nas/ dbang rjes gnang byin rlabs kyi bka' rnams btsugs/ so so'i lag len ma 'chugs par byed dgos pas zla ba gnyis tsam thogs/ zhag po bcu bcu la shing bu len pa sogs bar seng nyi ma re re dgos par byung*/ lung ni yongs su rdzogs pa rang bklags chos skyong gi skor rnams ma gtogs/ byin rlabs rjes gnang gi bka' thams cad song zhing*/ chos skyong skor nas kyang bdun brgyad gcig gi bka' byas/ nā ro mkha' spyod kyi byin rlabs sgrub sde rnams la yang byas shing*/ de skabs rten 'brel ci yin rung*/ rdo rje phag mo'i rigs dang*/ ku ru kul+le dmar chung skor gsum sogs mkha' 'gro ma'i chos skor gyi skabs thams cad du lag pa la shu ba'i rnam pa 'byung ba sogs cung zad 'tshub pa'i ltas byung*/ khro bo chos skyong sogs gang la yang 'tshub cha med de grol nas tshogs chen la gshed dmar lha lnga dang*/ bde mchog dril bu lus dkyil gyi dbang dang*/ rang res gsar du bsgrigs pa'i yi ge'i steng nas/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa slob dpon chen po kah+na pa skyod 'chang dbang po'i lugs kyi dbang bskur ba de legs par bsgrubs shing*/

slob mas shom mkhan mi 'dug ste/ rang gi lag nas bton pa'i mchod pa gtor ma tshogs sogs rgya bal gyi lugs bzhin du bzab rgyas rang byas/ sgrub pa mo grags pa rnams kyi kyang cho ga 'dzugs pa'i don la/ thog cig la dbang bskur byas/ skabs shig 'doms pa'i ri rtser gtor ma gtong thengs gcig la/ rdo sngon ma phyogs nas chu glang zhig tshur la byung chur zhugs pa dang*/ lan rting ma gcig la smon skyid kyi ltag tsam 'dir/ nya shin tu che ba 'dom bcu tsam yod pa zhig byang nas lhor bcad pa'ang*/ nged dang kun dga' dpal bzang gnyis kar gyis mthong*/ phyogs gzhan gyi klu 'ga' zhig 'dir 'ongs pa'i rtags su ni gda'/ de rjes sku 'bum gyi chos khri chen po'i steng nas/ skyes bu gsum gyi lam rim rgyas pa zhig dang*/ bde ba can gyi zhing bkod dang*/ mngon dga'i zhing bkod gyi mdo gnyis rgyab rten du bshad cing*/ lam rim gyi grub 'bras byangs lugs kyi sems bskyed chen po de mdzad pa snga srol du 'dug pa bzhin byas/ 'di skabs lha 'dongs pa'i chos rje bgres pa khong ra'i yum gyis bsngo zhus la khor tsam byung*/ dbyar smad chos rje phywa bka' bcu pa dang*/ bla ma dam pa ye shes dbang po'i nye gnas rig dpal ba gzhan 'ga' re dang bcas pa la blo sbyong cha tshang zhig bshad/ de dag dang grwa pa bsnyen rdzogs pa rnams la/ so so thar pa'i mdo'i bshad pa yongs su rdzogs par grub/ chos rje phywa pa sogs 'ga' shas la/ grub chen zhi ba sbas pa'i bzhed dgongs dgyes rdor nye rgyud lugs kyi dbang bka' rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs te bsgrubs/ lag len phra mo tshun chod rgya gar ba'i lugs bzhin byas pa/ glo bur du char 'babs pas dkyil 'khor gyi steng du chu 'bab pa sogs byung yang*/ dmigs pa brtad pas chu de yud tsam thub/ de 'phral snod bzed pas dkyil 'khor la gnod ma thub/ 'di skabs ka bzhi'i dbon po rnams kyi u tshugs chen pos bskul bas/

bla ma kun dga' bzang ldan dpon slob rnams khams phyogs 'gro don la brdzangs pa yin/ de nas btsas ma ran pa tsam la/ 'khyog po'i mkha' spyod bde ldan du phyin/ seng cig la rgyab ri sngon por skyong gi rtse mor zhag gcig bsdad/ gtor ma rgya cher btang*/ rang gzhan la phan pa rgya chen po 'grub pa'i ltas zhig kyang byung*/ byang stag lung du zhabs drung ma chen ngag dbang rnam par rgyal ba'i zhal snga nas kun spang gnang ba dang*/ zhabs drung dpon rin po che khri thog tu phebs pa la zhal dkar ja zhus bzab par phul/ de ka ma gtogs mtshams bsdams nas bsdad de/ zhag po nyi shu rtsa lnga tsam song*/ lo 'di la dus 'khor sgrub dkyil sogs rang res bsgrigs pa'i yig sna 'ga' shas/ mnga' ris rdzongs dkar du spar rko ba zhu ba dang*/ gong ma la ja zhus pa zab rgyas 'bul ba dang*/ spar gyi do dam la dkon mchog legs 'dzin pa brdzangs pa/ skabs 'dir 'khor byung zhing*/ de tsho'i lta rtog sogs la mtshams grol te/ dam chos gling rang du yongs/ 'di skabs gcung ri bo che pa'i dpon drung byung nas ri bo che rtse ba rnams nged la blo btod kyi tshul yang zhus shing*/ sde srid du phyag dam zhu dgos tsho yang zhu rigs byas shing byung ba'ang yin/ skabs mtshams cig la/ skyid phug tu mtshams dam pa zhig byas/ da lo rtag brtan du gtsang khang 'du khang rnams kyi steng thog khel dpal chen lha khang yang rags pa 'grub/ lha khang gzhan phal cher gyi rmangs tsam bting*/ lcags ri'i kha gso yongs rdzogs/ lcog rnams dang bcas pa po ta la'i thog 'og ma gnyis dang*/ steng thog kyang spyi skya rags pa grub/ lho'i phyogs kyis mtshams gcod pa'i lcags ri btags so thams cad dang*/ dpal ri dang sau raṣ+tar ming btags pa'i sgo spe'u 'di rnams rags rim dang*/ lho gling gi spyil po 'di rnams 'og thog phal cher grub/ gzhan yang sngar gyi 'phros la mang po grub ste/

lo 'di la sde pa gzhung nas kyang 'ug lag lo snga ma las mang nges shes pa zhig zla ba phyed dang lnga tsam zhig byung*/ ston gzhug nas grwa pa thams cad kyang rtag brtan nyid du byon te/ thog ma'i rten 'brel la 'du khang steng gi 'khor g.yabs 'dir/ snga dro'i dus su mdo sde skal bzang gi lung yang klags shing*/ kun mkhyen chen po'i gsung bden gnyis rnam par dbye ba'i bshad pa dang*/ thugs rje chen pa ོ 'i smar 'khrid yig rnying gi lung dang bcas pa sogs chos sna sad sud rnam grangs mang ba rang bshad/ 'khor g.yabs kyi ming bkod pa mtha' yas su btags/ sde pa snar thang pa yang gshegs pa'i 'di skabs bsngo zhus la mgon po gri gug gi gser sku sogs byung ba rten 'brel legs par go / de rjes ri bo che nas/ rgya dpe po ti bcu tsam sogs dpe cha 'ga' shas 'byor byung ba/ dus 'khor 'grel chen yar klung lo tsā ba'i phyag dpe ngos ma nyis pod zhig 'dug pa'i rgyud kyi dpe de dbus phyogs nas nged kyi lag tu snga mo zhig nas 'byor ba yin/ 'grel pa de kha'i gras de 'di skabs 'byor pa/ yid la ya mtshan skyes shing re mang klogs pas/ zung sbyor la yang blo skyed re ka thon byung*/ dbang mdor bstan gyi 'grel pa don dam bsdus pa dang*/ kyai rdo rje'i 'grel pa rdo rje'i tshig bsdus gnyis ka'i rgya dpe 'dug ste/ snga ma la mdzad byang nā ro pa'i mtshan 'byar ba de ka 'dugaphyi ma la sngar bod du 'gyur ba na/ kha che'i yul du skyes pa yi/ / dge slong snyan grags bzang pos byas/ / zer ba 'dug kyang rgya dpe 'di na snyan grags bzang po'i skad dod la ya sho bha dra zhes pa med par/ byang chub bzang po'i skad dod bo dhi bha dra zhes pa snang bas/ kha che byang chub bzang po'i yin zer rgyur 'dugasngar dpyal chos bzang gis bsgyur ba'i dus kyi kha che paṇa chen gyi rgya dpe la snyan grags bzang pos mdzad zer ba yod par 'dugader ma zad chag lo dang dā na shī la yang nā ros mdzad par bzhed/

dpang los 'gyur bcos mdzad pa la yang de bzhin du 'dug kyang*/ rgya dpe gzhan las byang chub bzang po 'dug pa mngon sum du mthong*/ mkhas pa chen po gzhan rnams thams cad nā ros mdzad par 'dod kyang*/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta ni nā ros ma mdzad par bzhed skad la/ gong ltar dpyad gzhi 'byung ba bden par snang ngo*/ / de nas mi ring bar ri khrod chen por lo dus kyi dgun khrid btsugs shing*/ yul nas a ma lags dang*/ dbon po yang ngaid 'phrad par 'byor byon/ 'di skabs rtag brtan du yang chos btsugs shing*/ gnyis kar du chos la yar mar du bgrod tshul re mos byas/ ri khrod du rgyab chos la ting nge 'dzin rgyal po'i mdo lung bklags/ rtag brtan du ni 'di skabs thun mong gi khrid zhen pa bzhi bral/ blo sbyong thun gcig ma dang*/ tshig rkang brgya dam snying po don gsum/ sum pa lo tsā ba'i blo sbyong*/ skyid sdug lam 'khyer gyi 'khrid/ sgrol dkar gyi 'khrid/ tshe dpag med grub rgyal lugs kyi 'khrid/ sems nyid ngal gso'i 'khrid/ de nyid rgya gzhung 'brel ba dang bcas pa'i lung*/ thun mong ma yin pa ku ru kul+le'i khrid sogs 'khrid thung rnam grangs mang ba zhig bshad/ 'di res dus 'khrid kyi 'khrid lo legs par byung*/ gshed dmar mngon rtogs kyi bshad pa yang 'di dus brtsams te nyi ma gsum la grub pa yin/ snar thar nas dpon sa yum sras kyang sa skyar bzhugs ma nus par skrag pas 'di phyogs su phebs byung zhing*/ sde pa rgyal bu'i drung yang chos skor 'jug pa mdzad/ khrid grol mtshams su yang gtsang sa nas 'bod mi gnang zhing*/ lnga sor sgar chen bsam 'grub rtse'i rdzong nang la spyan 'dren gnang ba'i dus/ spyir gong 'og thams cad du 'tshub cha dang*/ de nas gzung nas rjes su yang zla ba gnyis tsam cung zad 'tshub pa'i ngang dang*/ sde srid rang ser ma la brten pa'i sku khams lan cig long po rang yang byung*/

cung zad zi ba yang yang yong ba cig byung 'dugaspyir ni myong bar nges pa'i las kyi 'bras bu dang*/ bya ba byas zin/ 'bras bu grub zin du thal ba'i rigs la bcos thes med/ de min chags che nyams nga than thun rnams rim gro chang chung gis kyang bzlog na chen pos lta ci smos/ des na zhing gi mchog bla ma/ de'i nang nas kyang gzhan su dang mi 'dra ba'i lung med 'di lta bu la/ zhabs tog dang mchod pa'i yo byad bsam gyis mi khyab pa ni/ gzhan dge 'dun gyi sde kun dang*/ bla ma dge bshes gzhan kun la tshe gang du zhabs tog mdzad rgyu'i dngos po tsam/ 'dir nyin re'am zla re la'ang gtong dgos na/ sku dog chang chung yang bzlog mi thub pa'i khar/ bar chad gsar pa skyes yong ba 'di 'dra rang yang ci yin snyam/ yong btangs kyi sbyabs la blo skyog ge ba zhig zhag shas blo yul du byung*/

gang ltar 'phral myur du 'gro ba shar/ lam stabs bde zhing sa gtsang ba'i stabs chu byang brgyud nas phyin/ g.yag po ru bzhir sleb dus rtse nas lo gsar gyi skal pa skyel mkhan gnang ba yang 'byor/ rtser sleb 'phral nas gzung*/ thog mar tshe dbang grub rgyal ma brgya tshar/ lha dgu brgya tshar sogs dbang rjes gnang rkyen sel gyi rigs rnams gtso bor phul/ bgegs bskrod dang khrus gsol gyi rigs mang du byas pas/ nged sleb nas shin tu 'jam par byung*/ re zhig gi rkyen sel de tsam gyis lcogs par 'dugayun ring rab sdod dgos phyin/ chos rnam par dag pa de snyan du gsol dgos snyam nged ra'i blo la yang byung*/ sde srid rang gi dgongs pa la yang de kho na bzhin 'dug pa rtse mthun du byung nas/ chos kyi rtsa ba skyabs 'gro dang*/ skyabs 'gro'i rtsa ba dad pa yin zhing*/ dad pa'i rtsa ba ston pa bcom ldan 'das kyi rnam thar go ba la rag las pas/ ston pa'i rnam thar rgyas pa 'dul ba las 'byung ba rnams kyi nang nas/ lo rgyus sde tshan che ba re tsam gnyis tsam re la chos than thun re byas pa dang*/ 'jig rten bstan bzhag gi go ba zhib cing gsal la 'gril ba rim can du phul ba'i go ba yongs rdzogs dang*/ bshes pa'i 'phrin yig la thun mong ma yin pa'i legs bshad gsar pa du mas brgyan pa'i bshad tshoms rgya che ba dang bcas te bshad/ bshes 'phrin dang 'jig rten bstan bzhag gnyis ka la 'dzin chos rgyas pa gnang ba'i thugs rtsol bla na med pa mdzad zin bris yi ger 'god pa mdzad pa yang shin tu dag pa gzhan pas ches phun sum tshogs pa byung*/ sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal 'di tshig 'dzin spus gtsang zhing*/ don la yang go babs shin tu bzang ba'i thugs rab khyad par can rang yin par 'dugabashes 'phrin gyi bshad pa 'go btsugs pa'i nyin/ ri bo che nas rgya dpe pod chung zhig bskur byung ba/ de'i nang na bshes 'phrin yongs rdzogs kyang 'dugamago zhabs na sh+lau ka re re lhag po zhig kyang snang*/

'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang spyod pa yi/ / zhes sogs kyi bshad pa'i skabs su/ bcu gcig zhal la klu sgrub kyi sku mang pos bskor ba'i thang ga ster mkhan zhig kyang byung bas/ phyi nang gi rten 'brel ngo mtshar can du yid ches/ sngar gyi 'grel pa thams cad ni bsdus don sna zing spu zing las lam rim rkang tshugs mi 'dug pa la/ bsdus don gyi rkang sgrig tshul khyad par can cig blo la shar ba 'di/ 'phags pa nyid kyi byin rlabs yin no zhes pa'i brda don yin par mngon no/ / gzhung 'di'i don rnams shin tu thugs la 'phrod par yang byung*/ 'di skabs sdod sa li ma lha khang dang thag nye bas/ phyag mchod smon lam yang yang thub pas shin tu dga' bar byung*/ chos bzang nyi mas se rib kyi grwa rgyun gsar pa 'dra yang khrid nas sleb/ khong tsho la ma dā na pu ra nas/ tsan+d+ra shing rgyal pos dung bzang po gcig ngaid la bskur gda'/ 'di skabs shig rgya gar yul gyi bi mā na 'dra ba'i gur zhig 'tsho ba gnang 'dug pa'i rab gnas dang bstun gser mdog can pa'i tshogs pa rnams mtshan brjod la yod pa la/ chos 'brel rjes gnang gsum pa cig dang*/ mkhan slob rnams la kyai rdor nag po lugs kyi dbang cig byas/ brag dmar mkhan chen la yang rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i chos skor ci rigs pa zhig bshad skabs shig la yar 'brog bsam sdings kyi rje btsun ma o mtsho pa dpon slob rnams kyang mnga' ris gung thang phyogs la thegs pa'i zhor lam sde pa mjal bar phebs/ thal rlung chen pos rgya gling cha pa sogs/ khong rang dpon slob kyi 'phrin las la bar chad kyi ltas du ma mthong sel thabs byas na bar chad de sel ba dka' las mi 'dug ste/ khong dpon slob tsho rang dgos don med pa'i 'gran zla'i khungs rang 'dug pas/ bcol gtogs med pa de bzhag pa rang legs pa 'duga'abras spungs thams cad mkhyen pa'i sprul pa'i sku la lha sar dar 'dzugs pa'i dus de lta bur nged kyi rten 'brel sgrigs na/

gang spyir phan pa'i thabs shig yod pa yin te/ lho kha la thegs pas stabs ma 'griga'adi skabs sku yal ba'i thugs dam gsal 'debs kyi rten bzab par byung*/ skabs der 'dar gdong bde gling pa gsum la/ bka' bkyon dbyings che ba byung ba la yang*/ zhu ngo gang drag rang zhus pas/ mdar du mkhar bshig tsam byas pas gzhan bde bar byung ba dang*/ gdong dga' nas kyang gser mdog can du bzhugs dgos tsam las/ rdzong gzhis sa cha gsar gnang rnams la skyon ma byung ba dang*/ bde gling pa yang bde bar bsdad chog pa byung*/ sngon ma 'dar ba'i snying khungs kyi steng nas 'brog rigs rnams ma byung ba la zhu ngo bskyar chags zhus nas slar gnang ba yin/ lar mi 'di rnams la phan thogs byung tshad de 'phral brjed 'gro bar 'dugayang brjed pa'i 'phro la mi bde ba re byung na khu long g.yab gda' yo rang dgos pa gcig kyang gda'/ de nas hor zla gsum pa'i nyer gsum la yar bteg nas 'ongs/ bkra shis lhun po'i mdun der drung chen dang*/ lhun grub sgang pas ja 'dren zhig byung*/ yangs par thab bsu'i sar 'brug sgra shin tu che ba bstud mar yong ba dang*/ gangs char chen pos lung ba dkar por song ba zhig byung ste/ nged rang la ni rten 'brel legs par go / snar thang du chos sde'i bsu ba ser bsgrengs dang bcas sleb/ snar thang sde pa'i shul gyi thang ka ci rigs sde srid rang gi phyag tu gzhes pa'i lhag ma phal che ba rnams dang*/ dpe cha rnams las ji ltar mkho che ba rnams rtag brtan gyi chos sde gsar 'dings la mkho che bar yongs 'dug pas/ khyer thong gsung ba'i bka' lung yod pa ltar/ de tsho blta rtog la zhag po gsum bsdad/ rgyal rtse mngon dga' nas yin pa'i rgya dpe 'ga' re lag tu 'byor/ rgya dpe 'di tsho dang po rang thar pa nas spyan drangs par 'duga'adir byung ba'i tshe mdo'i rgya dpe gcig la gzugs sngags oṃ gnyis ma kho na yin par 'duga.oṃ gsum ma'i rgya dpe yang sngar nas nged kyi lag na yod/

des na ngor chen gyi gsung bgraus dpal gyi rgya mtshan pa'i zin bris sogs tshe mdo'i bshad pa gsum bzhi gcig na/ oṃ gnyis ma ma dag lo paṇa yon la ma mgu bar sngags kyi gung nas bcad pa yin zer ba kho na 'dug pa yang*/ rna gtam rgad po la yid brtan bcas pa'i cal col kho nar bas/ rgya dpe rang la oṃ gnyis ma yod pas so/ / de nas byang chen du yang phyin/ 'di skabs rgyal chen rtse'i phyogs kyi nang la babs te/ phug mo chos rdzong gi mda' byams gling sogs dang*/ shab kyi mda' dang rog tsho sogs brgyud pa'i gtsang po lho kha yin pa la'i byang kho na brgyud nas yongs/ rtag brtan du hor zla bzhi pa'i tshes gsum la sleb/ 'di'i res la brel pa de tsho'i stabs kyis/ nag pa'i nya la rang res ma sleb pa dang*/ rtag brtan du dus kyi 'khor lo'i sgrub mchod tshugs pa'i thog ma yin pas/ cho ga'i 'go la rang re yod pa rang zhig dgos par byung nas/ snga gong ri khrod du nag nya lan gnyis song ba de yin kyang*/ rtag brtan du 'dzugs pa'i thog ma de sa ga la byung ba/ de phyin chad kyang sa ga nyid la byas so/ / 'di skabs sgrub mchod sngar 'khyud ltar las/ grwa rigs dus 'khor gyi dbang bskur ma thob pa re mang 'dug pa rnams la/ dbang bcu gcig po yongs rdzogs zhig byas/ chos sde nang gi bla ma slob dpon dang grwa rigs gal che ba gnyis gsum dang*/ 'jag pa bla ma dang*/ slob dpon bkra shis phun tshogs dang bcas pa yongs dril bco brgyad la rdo rje slob dpon bdag po'i dbang dang*/ bdag po chen po'i dbang yongs su rdzogs par bsgrubs/ zla ba de ka'i nyi shu bdun la/ chos sde rnams chos lung byang rtser chos bar la byon/ rtag brtan gyis las ka rnams kyang tshugs/ nged kyis ri khrod nyid du bsdad/ chos rje ye shes rgya mtsho ba la gsang 'dus skor gyi chos mang po dang*/ sbyor drug gsar ma'i 'khrid lag len bshad bka' dang bcas pa sogs chos mang rab bshad cing*/

gang bshad pa de rna mchog gi gong kha la ma song ba'i nges tig can ngag sgros rnams la yang zin bris thebs pa'i bshad pa la/ rjes yod par byung*/ rje bud+dha nā tha de gho ra ṭaṃ ṭa na bzhugs kyi yod 'dug grwa rigs dzo gi pho mo gnyis bod la byung*/ lho phyogs kyi dpe cha sgrol ma'i rgyud 'grel cig byin byung*/ slob dpon bkra shis phun tshogs pa khams la 'byon pa'i 'dod chos dbang rjes gnang khrid sogs rnam grangs mang ba nyin re bzhin dang*/ bden mchog rtse pa gzhi grwa thams cad dang bcas pa la kun rig gi dbang zhig kyang byas/ 'di skabs rgya gar yul dbus wā rā ṇa sī nas/ bram ze paṇ+ḍi ta kṛṣ+ṇa zhes bya ba sgra sogs phyi rol gyi rigs gnas la shin tu byang ba/ bye brag pa dang*/ rig pa can pa dang*/ rig byed mtha' pa'i gzhung gsum la shin tu sbyangs pa che ba zhig khyad par sgra la ches mkhas pa'i grub 'bras saṃ skri ta'i skad la byang ba'i mthar thug pa rang cig bram ze'i bu lon ma khyer ba'i slong mo la byung bas/ khong la dbyangs can ma'i sgra mdo nas cung zad nyan/ dgos pa rang mi 'dug kyang rtsed mo tshul du lha kṛṣ+ṇa'i gsung legs ldan gyi glu nas le'u gnyis dang*/ khyab 'jug chen po'i mtshan stong gi 'go rgyangs phan yon de bsgyur/ de rjes dbyangs can byā ka ra ṇa'i 'go nas mtshams sbyor bud tsam bsgyur cing*/ khyad par du don che ba la/ ri bo che nas byung ba'i rgya dpe'i seb na/ dpal ldan ka lā par sgrod thabs kyi gzhung bal po'i dpe zhig byung ba/ kha yig la ka lā pā ba ta ra zhes 'dug pas sgra mdo ka lā pa'i bshad pa zhig yin nam snyam nas sgra'i gseb kyi rgya dpe'i sdebs la bcug 'dugagang ltar de yongs su rdzogs par bsgyur bas ngo mtshar che bar byung*/ spyir sngon gyi lo rgyus la sham+bha la'i lam yig dang po ta la'i lam yig sogs rdo rje gdan kyi sgo'i rdo khang na yod ces 'byung ba'i sham+bha la'i lam yig de 'di yin par 'duga'adi 'phags pa don yon lcags kyus gsungs pa yin/

po ta la'i lam yig de sngar 'gyur nas bstan 'gyur du chug pa 'di yin te/ rje btsun ma sgrol mas gsungs pa yin/ 'di gnyis kar rgyud kyi rigs su gtogs par byed dgos tshul 'di mthong nas sngar gnas skor ba gcig gis sham+bha lar phyin no skad pa skye bo mi nag pa rnams kyi lag tu 'khyams yod pa'i rdzun gtam de ches rdzun par go nus so/ / dpal lha mo'i mtshan stong gi rgya dpe lag na yod cing*/ 'di dngos nang pa'i gzhung rang ni min pa 'dug na'ang*/ bod kyi lha mo'i bstod rnying kun na/ mi gcig ma la ming dgu ma/ mtshan brgya ma la mtshan stong ma/ / mtshan brgya dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma/ / gang nas bos kyang khyod kyi ming*/ / bya ba la sogs pa 'dug pa la/ gzhan rnams la rgya gar lugs dang mthun mi mthun ji ltar yang*/ bod rang la ngos 'dzin rgyu re 'dun pa byin rlabs dang yang ldan par grags la/ mtshan stong ni bod pa la ngos 'dzin rgyu mi 'dug cing*/ 'di kho na yin par snang bas bsgyur 'dod de bshad pa tshar gcig nyan bod skad du 'bebs par brtsams na/ gnyan cha cho 'phrul che ba rang gis de res 'jog dgos pa byung*/ paṇ+ḍi ta'i bu lon sbyang ba'i phyir/ rang res kyang bum gdan kha gang ma gcig dang gser sogs gang drag phul/ shis brjod sh+lau ka gnyis khong rang gis brtsams/ de nged kyi bsgyur ba'i skad gnyis shan sbyar gyi dpe dang bcas te/ sde srid sku gzhogs su brdzangs pa/ zhabs drung yab sras dga' ba tshal nas tshur phebs/ 'tshoms chen du bzhugs gral zhal dkar bzhes rgyu zhabs drung rgyal bu bzhugs gral chen mo la phebs pa'i thog ma de dang 'dzom/ khong gis shis brjod kyang phul gda'/ rten 'brel yang legs po yin shes 'dugashin tu dgyes pa byung ba'i gser srang gcig sogs gnang sbyin yang bzang bar byung*/ khong rang yang mgu bas rgya gar du thegs/ chos lung tshogs kyi mkhan chen rnying pa ngam ring mkhan po lhun rab pa yang nged 'phrad par phebs/

chos bka' than thun dgos gsung ba la de mthun byas/ slar gsang 'dus rim lnga zhu ba la yongs gsung gin 'dugaphyis phebs ni ma thub/ dbyar gung gcig chos rje ye shes rgya mtsho ba dang*/ rang de'i dbon po sogs dam tshig gtsang ba nyung bsdus gcig la/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i gsang ba'i rjes gnang thun mong ma yin pa rang re'i pha chos de yang byas/ sa skyar bdag chen rgyan pa gshegs/ sku mched phyis thugs nye ring yong khun yin kyang*/ dang po'i brnag pa cig thugs la yod pa los yin/ zhabs drung khri chen dgyes grags nas zhabs bro mdzad pa'i grags pa yang byung*/ gdong rgyud bgres gzhon gnyis kyi dang po rtsa ba'i bla ma khri chen rang yin kyang bar skabs gzigs phyogs mi gcig pa'i skabs 'dir dngos su thugs 'gal/ gdung brgyud a mis drung la mdzad bka' gtsang sar zhu sgugs la phebs dgos byung*/ nged la ngo chen dgos phebs pa sde srid du nan bcags zhus pas yon mchod du yang 'brel/ lcang gseb ber chen sogs sku skal ma pham tsam byung ba yin/ phyis drin sems par mi mdzad do/ / dbyar smad rang re'i lag g.yog sgrub pa byas pa/ kun dga' rin chen pa dpon slob tsho yang khams phyogs la thegs/ sbyor drug gi bshad pa bar skabs su g.yeng bas 'bri 'phro la lus pa de ston ser kha 'dir ched gtad bris/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i rdzogs rim gyi rnam bshad 'di yig sna mgos che ba la the ba tsam byung*/ dbyar gzhug 'di la snga phyi rim can du sde srid kyi rdzong ltar gnang ste dbus chu shul khog dang*/ kyi shod phyogs dang*/ gra dol gzhung gsum 'phrang po rnams nas grwa gsar brgya lhag pa yang 'byor/ lo 'di'i nang du rtag brtan du ni gtsang khang gi steng*/ 'og min lha khang du dus 'khor rgyal ba rigs lnga rgyal ba rigs drug gnas gtsang ma'i steng gi 'og min bkod pa sogs logs bris legs pa grub pa dang*/

gtsug lag khang chen mo gtsang khang sgo khang dang bcas pa'i shing rtsi dang*/ gzhan yang shing rtsi dgos pa'i rigs than thun mang du grub cing*/ chos bzang du ming bzhag pa'i sde yangs chen mo dang*/ nub kyi lha khang gsum/ shar gyi lha khang gsum/ gzhal yas khang du ming bzhag pa'i gtsang khang ka bzhi kha che lugs dang 'khyams ka ba bcu drug pa dang*/ lha khang gzhan rnams kyi yang 'og thog phal cher khel/ byang gling gi khang pa thams cad kyi 'og thog khel zhing*/ cha phyed tsam steng thog kyang khel ba dang*/ 'bras spungs zhol gyi 'og thog dang*/ po ta la'i steng khang sogs ji snyed cig grub/ u tsa lar mtshan gsol ba'i mgon khang 'di/ thog 'og ma gnyis lo snga ma dang steng thog lo 'di la phub/ de skabs mgon lug gcig yod pa de/ mgon khang byed rgyu de'i sgo 'og kho nar nyal ba dang*/ 'u lag pa re gnyis las ka mi byed par yib cing nyal ba la/

lug des ched gtad 'tshol du phyin nas brdungs/ shing las la bskul ba sogs chos skyong 'khor ba'i ltas mang du byung cing*/ de dus rten bcas pa med kyang*/ mgon po'i bzhugs sa byed rgyu yin byas pa tsam gyi bdag byed par 'dugalo 'di la'ang sde pa gzhung nas 'u lag sngar khyud ltar gnang zhing*/ las rjes shin tu che ba de yin/ 'di rjes nas sde pas zug mi rang rdzong ltar gnang ba med/ mchod gzhis pa kho nas byas pa yin/ lo snga ma gsum gzhung dang mchod bzhis gnyis kar log nas byas pa dang grub che chung rang khyad chen ma byung*/ 'di'i ston gzhug nas chos sde'i grwa pa rnams kyang rtag brtan rang du gzhi phab pa yin/ khams phyogs nas brda du sku skye sogs 'ga' shas la sbyor drug cha tshang zhig bshad/ sa skya zhabs drung khri chen gyi bka' skyon byung dogs pa'i 'jigs bros la jo nang du bsdad pa'i rab 'byams pa te ba sogs 'ga' shas la/ gcod khrid zhib pa zhig kyang byas/ rtsas chod skor la dkon legs pa la 'dod chos 'dra bshad kyin yod skabs/ ri bo che pa'i rje drung ngag dbang pa khu mtshan gnyis kyang 'byor/ rje drung skal bzang pa'i sras po de skra bcad par mdzad/ khong gi bzhed pa chos chung brgya rtsa'i lung zhig kyang bklags/ de nas rtag brtan du tshogs chen la sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'i rjes gnang rgya gzhung gi lung dang bcas pa yang byas/ skyes bu gsum gyi lam rim bsdus tsam zhig kyang bshad/ skabs 'dir sog po'i rgyal po che chen das chin 'das pa'i mang ja bsngo rten sogs byung zhing*/ mi sna mi rgan sa 'byin zer ba de/ snga sor stag lo dgun ka jo nang du byung ba dgon gnas gsar 'dings byed rgyu yin zer ba'i gling brjod cig yod pas/ de brdzun ma yin par bden par 'dug ngo mtshar che zer/ de rjes gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor bzhi/ gshin rje gshed dmar po bcu gsum ma nag po bcu gsum ma rwa lugs/

ma rgyud sgyu thod gdan gsum sogs kyi dbang bskur byas/ dkon legs pas ched kyis zhus nas tshogs chen la gshin rje gshed nag po zhang lugs kyi dbang de yang byas/ khams nas yar re shing pa'i sku skye spyan 'dren la arke sku skye dang*/ 'dzam thang gnyer ba rgyal ba dpal sogs mang po zhig byung ba/ skabs 'dir 'di phyogs su sleb/ thams cad la mchog dbang sogs chos 'brel 'ga' zhig dang*/ arke sku skye la dus kyi 'khor lo'i rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang yang byas/ rje drung ngag dbang pa sogs la 'khrid brgya'ang bshad/ de nas dus 'khrid kyang sngar khyud ltar bcugs/ khams pa khrom tshugs sku skye/ sgang pa dbon po sdom tsa dbon po ste bla tshugs 'dzin pa gsum po de sogs khams pa nyi shu rtsa 'dren zhig sbyor drug la zhugs dam po rgyab pa yin/ 'di skabs lho rong na 'brug pa ra lung ba la brten pa'i dus 'khrug dang*/ byang rgyab smad na sog po'i 'du 'tshog gi skabs de yin/ gting skyes nas bde skyid lags kyang dam po 'debs par phebs/ dam po grol nas chos mdzad pa yin/ skabs der o la pa ti'i rim bzhi'i ṭī ka de yang brtsams sangs rgyas thod pa dang*/ ye shes dbang phyug ma'i sgrub dkyil sogs kyang bris pa yin/ drang srong pa sogs byang gi dpon ris mang dag zhig dbus la 'gro dgos byung ba'i dus de yin pa drang srong pa mar lam yongs dus nged la bshags pa 'bul zer/ 'dir skor tsam byung*/ bshags pa yang blangs/ hor zla gnyis pa'i skabs shig la nang cig gnod sbyin k+ṣe dra pā la dang*/ las kyi gshin rje yin snyam pas mi nag po gnyis kyis/ nag hril ba cig sdir sgra dang bcas te mdun du bskyur dam nyams kyi mgo 'di re zer/ bltas pas rtsibs ri bsam gling gi mkhan po rgya mtsho pad dkar ba'i mgo bor 'dugade nas mi ring bar khong 'das/ nged kyis rbad bskul byas kyang ma byas dgos kyang dgos pa med/

khong rang bla ma dam pa bde bar gshegs pa de la sgo gcig ma yin pa thams cad nas dam nyams pa des yin par gda'o/ / rtag brtan du dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i dkyil 'khor zhang lugs zhe dgu ma/ skyo lugs gshin rje mo brgyad kyis bskor ba/ mal lugs ro langs brgyad bskor/ rwa lugs bcu gsum ma rnams/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor dang*/ rwa lugs ro langs brgyad skor la rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor mchod pa rgyas pa dang bcas pa sgrubs te/ grwa pa thams cad la dbang bskur/ tshogs kyi khri gsar pa'i byin rlabs la/ phyag na rdo rje 'khor lo chen po'i dbang bskur dang*/ lha khang gzhal yas khang gi khyams su sngar ma thob pa'i rigs rnams la mi 'khrugs pa/ tshe dpag med/ bde mchog nag po pa/ dril bu pa/ gshed mar lha lnga sogs kyi dbang bskur byas/ de bzhin du gshin rje gshed dmar po'i khrid spros med dang*/ rnal 'byor bzhi rim gnyis nag po zhang lugs kyi 'khrid rnal 'byor bzhi pa dang*/ 'jigs byed skyo lugs kyi 'khrid rwa rtse sems 'dzin dang*/ gshed dmar lugs gnyis la brten pa'i byin rlabs kyi bka' bcu gsum tsam ste/ de thams cad tshogs chen rang la byas pa yin/ 'di skabs sangs rgyas rabs bdun gyi sku bzhengs pa'i mgo tshugs pa yin pa la/ rang re'i grwa pa cig gis rgya gar rdo rje gdan 'khor ba'i byang chub shing gi yal ga lag ngar tsam cig dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i zhabs rjes kyi spar 'ga' re byang chub shing lo mang po dang bcas pa 'byor byung ba/ gzungs bzhugs kyi rten 'brel 'grig par 'dugasmon 'gro ba'i rgyal bu tshe dbang lhun grub pa yang lugs legs byed nges par mjal kha dgos zer nas phrad tsam byas/ ri bo che nas slob gnyer grwa rgyun gsar pa thog ma rnams kyang skabs 'dir 'byor/ sa ga'i sgrub mchod kyang sngar lugs bzhin byas pa las/ grwa pa gsar pa dus 'khor gyi dbang ma thob pa shin tu mang ba nas/

dkyil 'khor de ka'i steng nas slob ma'i dbang yongs su rdzogs pa tshar gcig byas/ de rjes kyang nged kyis sngon 'bor skyong gi rtse mo la gtor ma chen po sgrub pa'i phyir sang 'gro rgyu'i de ring de/ gro khud pa sde srid nas yar gnang ba 'byor/ spyir sku rim rgya che ba gnang 'dugakhong sgos su sgrub sde dang rtag brtan la mang ja 'gyed sogs sku rim rgya cher mdzad pa dang*/ sde srid sog po'i steng du dpung 'degs gnang rgyu'i bsrung 'khor sogs kyis gsung ba'i gsal 'debs su 'dugagator ma chen po yang stabs 'grig pa sbyin bdag chen po'i bar chad sel ba la ni dmigs/ 'di skabs pha rol po zhwa gser thogs yin kyang*/ nged ni rje btsun tsong kha pa chen po la lhag par mos/ dge phyogs pa 'di pa dang*/ lhag par 'bras spungs kyi chos grwa la nye sems bag chags mthug pa zhig yod/ gnod sems ga la zhigachos grwa de dag tu chos dar bar smon pa dang*/ rtsod pa 'jam po'i phyogs su zhi bar smon lam btab pa yin kyang*/ de'i dbang du 'gro ba zhig mi 'dugaphan tshun gnyis ka las ngan gyis bdas pa la thabs ci byar yod/ dbyar stod de grwa pa thams cad la/ gsang 'dus rim lnga mar lugs mgos lugs gnyis/ ye shes zhabs kyi zab gsal dang grol ba'i thig le/ de dag gi rgyab rten rgya bod kyi gzhung dang bcas pa thams cad bshad/ rgyud kyi skor la rtsa rgyud kyi lung tsam ma gtogs/ 'grel pa sogs gzhan ma song*/ man ngag mtha' rgyas rang du song ba yin te/ grwa gzhon thams cad rtsed mo la yengs/ rgan pa thams cad kyi rna ba'i gong kha la song ba'i blo la bcags rgyu dang blo skyed thon pa lta ci smos/ chos ga 'dra cig thob bshad rgyu yang med pa'i byis pa mdo med cig ka byung*/ lo 'di'i sos ka dang dbyar gyi ring sdod sa po ta lar byas/ khams dwangs shing shin tu skyid/ sbyin sreg nub 'ga' shas byas/

shin tu zil che ba dang*/ sbyin sreg gi tha mar drug cu rtsa bzhi'i gtong ma gtor res kyi gtor ma'i khar sdig pa rwa can re dngos su yong pa sogs shin tu rtsub par mngon kyang*/ 'di skor la brten pa'i yon bdag gi sku dog thams cad sel/ rang re'i bar chad kyang mang po sel 'duga'adi skabs re shing nas sku skye yang phebs/ 'dzam thang phyogs la phebs 'dod stabs/ dge bsnyen dge tshul dge slong gi bar du chos sgor 'jug pa dang*/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang yongs rdzogs/ sbyor drug gi mgyogs 'khrid/ blo sbyong*/ nai gu/ kun rig gi dbang*/ nyer mkho'i rjes gnang*/ tshe dbang sogs ci rigs gsan te thegs song*/ arke sku skyes rjes su yang sbyor drug gi khrid zhim mor nyan/ bde mchog la sogs pa'i chos bka' gzhan yang mang du zhus song*/ dbyar gung nas gzung*/ chos bzang gi chos khri'i kha 'bebs la/ theg mchog rab tu rgyas pa'i dbu ma chen po rnam par nges pa de brtsams shing*/ brtsams grub rim nas bshad pa 'tshams pa re bshad/ zhag nyi shu rtsa gnyis tsam la cha tshang bar 'gril/ 'di rtsom pa'i blo shar ba'i dus/ tho rangs kha cig gnyid du song ba ni min/ da lta'i snang ba 'di nub nas sa gzhi ri bo nags tshal thams cad rin po che dang 'dra ba dang*/ mtsho rdzing me tog du mas brgyan pa sogs dang gzhal med khang dpag tu med pa na/ sangs rgyas re re la 'khor byang chub sems dpa' mang po mang pos bskor ba yod snyam pa dang*/ khyad par dbus kyi phyogs na ljon shing rgyas pa mtha' med pa gcig gi rtsa ba na/ sku tshad nags rgyal gyi ri 'di bas kyang ldab kyi mtho ba'i sangs rgyas sa gnon gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa cig 'dug pa de/ 'o skol gyi ston pa yin snyam pa byed cing*/ sku'i g.yas na byang chub sems dpa' dkar po gangs ri tsam pa cig 'duga'ajam dbyangs yin snyam pa byed/ g.yon na de tsam dmar po zhig 'dugaspyan ras gzigs yin snyam pa byed/

/ dkar po de'i yang g.yas na ser po zhig 'dug byams pa yin snyam/ g.yon rang na sngon po zhig 'dug pa de/ phyag rdor yin nam nam mkha'i snying po yin nam snyam pa las ha cang nges gsal ma byung*/ nga 'phags pa kun tu bzang po ga na bzhugs snyam tsa na/ ljon shing de bas kyang sku gzugs ring ba/ sku mdog ma nges pa sku'i nang thams cad na me long la gzugs brnyan shar ba ltar bkod pa mtha' yas pa yod pa cig 'dugagazhan 'khor tshad gzung med pas bskor/ thams cad kyang bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po las brtsams chos gsung ba'i snang ba byung*/ zhing khams 'di gang na yod zhus pas/ khyod rang gi snying gi dkyil na yod gsung*/ dum cig nas snang ba de yang 'gags/ de'i rgyun las zhag mang po'i bar du rig pa gsal zhing dwangs pa/ 'char sgo mtha' yas pa shar yang thams cad spros bral du gnas pa/ dga' bde'i cha shas kyis brgyan pa nyin mtshan kun tu byung*/ gnyid kyang ngos gzung med pa'i ting nge 'dzin de kha la gnas/ gdams ngag rnams nas rnam gsum rigs dbye bshad pa de/ las dang po pa re dogs can la dogs pa yin/ re dogs dang dga' sdug med na rnam gsum rigs dbyes ci byed/ de dgos pa byungatsam nyid nas cher kha shor/ sangs rgyas mthong yang zhen rgyu med/ sdig sbrul mthong yang sun rgyu med/ bdud nag mthong yang stong nyid snying rje'i ngang*/ yi dam mthong yang nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon gyi tshul du 'dugaro mnyam gcig la khyad par ta gang yang mi 'dug kyang*/ rten 'brel ma 'gags pa'i 'char tshul de 'dra cig byung*/ lar dus kyang shin tu tha mar sleb pa'i ltas los yin yod/ lo 'di la lha sa'i mi bsad chen mo dang*/ ser dang 'bras spungs sogs stong la khang pa'i dge ldan pa'i gya nyes chen mo de yang byung*/ de rjes ston gyi ring la/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis/ ltung bshags/ dkon mchog rjes dran/ byams smon/ sgrol ma/ tshe mdo/ phyag rgya lnga'i mdor grags pa sde/

tshigs bcad gcig pa/ gnyis pa/ bzhi pa/ sgo drug pa/ bzang spyod rnams la 'grel pa re brtsams pa yang shin tu rtsom 'bab pa zhig byung*/ 'di skabs mdog smon gro nas lha rtse rdzong du rgyugs pa'i gzings gzhi mang po byas/ rdzong nas spe'u ba tshe dbang rdo rje bas nged kyi mchod gzhis 'dra'i sar bcom rgyag byed zer nas dmag bskul byas/ khong rang rta thog tu 'khyon ma thag gnam gzer byung nas sa la lhung*/ de nas mi ring bar rdzongadapon yang shor ba yin/ de rjes nas dus gzings kyang zhi ba'i skabs/ du ba mjug rings gnyis shar ba de byung*/ ston gzhug gi chos dang dgun chos kyi tshul du rang res brtsams pa'i 'grel ba de kha'i steng nas/ ltung bshags/ byams smon/ dkon mchog rjes dran sogs kyi bshad pa re yang byas/ lo 'di'i dpyid ka nas de yan chad kyi bar la mkhar las kyi rigs lho byang gi lha khang sngar steng thog ma khel ba thams cad khel/ lha khang rnams kyi logs zhal mthil zhal sogs zhib cha rnams dang*/ gzhal yas khang gi steng dang*/ lho gling gi spyil po thams cad kyi steng thog/ shar nub byang gsum gyi gling la yang steng thog ma khel ba rnams kyang khel/ rtse dang zhol gnyis kar du spyil po gsar pa yang mang du grub/ mkhar las sngar las kyang grub che ba tsam byung*/ sbus khyim pa dpon slob 'ga' shas dang*/ gtso bor gzhi pa'i lha ris pa rnams kyis gtsug lag khang chen mo'i logs ris rim gyis grub/ lha khang bde ba can gyi logs bris kyang grub cing*/ 'jam dpal lha khang gi logs bris kyang cha phyed grub/ sgo khang gi rgyal chen bzhi yang lo 'di la ka bris pa yin/ gtso che shos bal po bzo bo nyi shus sangs rgyas dpa' bo bdun gyi sku bzhengs pa la/ gtso bo ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya'i rgyal po dang*/ 'khor gyi tshul du gzhan drug yin pa las/ gtso bo dang bcom ldan 'das rnam gzigs dang rin chen gtsug tor can de gsum po de/

hor zla bzhi pa'i 'go nas gzung*/ brgyad pa'i tshes bcu gsum tshun la gzungs bzhugs yan chad legs par grub/ rigs ldan gyi thang sku sum cu so bdun dang*/ sngags sku thang mo che 'ga' re yang 'di yan chad la legs par zin/ tshes bcu bzhi gza' skar bzang ba nas brtsams de/ zla ba'i 'phros de ka la/ gsang 'dus 'jig rten dbang phyuga'akhor lo bde mchog lū hi pa/ gshin rje gshed nag po rdo rje 'jigs byed/ mi g.yo bla med/ phyag na rdo rje gtum mo/ phag mo lha so bdun ma rdo rje bdag med ma rnams kyi dkyil 'khor ras bris la brten nas/ rab gnas tshar re byas pas/ tshar brgyad dang*/ zla ba dgu pa'i yar tshes gsum pa gza' skar bzang ba la/ rab gnas chen mo/ dga' ston can de byas pa yin te/ gnam gang gi nyin mo sa chog byas/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor thugs dkyil rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs pa'i steng nas yin pas rab gnas tshar dgu song*/ nyin re bzhin sku'i gzi byin rgyas pa sogs byin rlabs kyi rtags mtshan mtha' med pa dang*/

bum pa'i nang du yungs dkar lhungs pa la/ myu gu sdong bu me tog shar ba'i bar du byung*/ dge 'dun rnams dang phu nas sgrub sde yongs rdzogs phebs pa rnams la mang ja gsum sbrel/ tsha ra nas 'gyed/ skye bo mang po rang shugs kyis 'dus pa la/ nas 'gyed sogs zhal dro bying chags par byung*/ skya ser thams cad la rten mjal yang legs par btang*/ de ltar na thub pa'i dbang po sogs sangs rgyas gsum po de'i sku gzugs la/ rgyu zangs khal nyis brgya nyi shu tsam/ skud gser zho stong phrag gsum tsam/ tha na rtsi la yang sha dkar zho drug cu/ ti tsha nya ga lnga bcu tsam/ dngul zho brgya dang sum cu skor song zhing*/ dga' ston chen mo 'di'i gnas skabs su/ bal po lha bzo ba rnams la yon/ bkra shis kha btags bco brgyad/ gser spyi legs pa/ gser sil ma srang bzhi/ g.yu legs pa drugagayu rna rna rgyangs lnga/ yang g.yu rna chig 'dogs gcigadangul phor bcu/ gan dkar legs pa rgya shubs can/ kha thi sogs gos yug sne tshad bcu/ rgya gos gcigadar sman tshe dang byar dar yug nyi shu/ bkra shis kha btags kyi yol ba gcigasman tshe'i yol ba gnyis/ ja sig sum cu/ bur tang lnga/ g.yas shag gser shog ma nyi shu/ dong pa gser shog ma cha tshang gsum/ stag sgam cha/ gzig sgam cha/ stag khom cha/ dom khom cha/ dngul sga gcigagazhan yang dung chas/ mdo ba chas/ pa ri sogs phran bu rnam grangs mang po dang*/ ka yug sne tshang bcu/ spun mdab/ gon ma/ ras yug dkyus ma sne tshad rnams nyi shu nyi shu rta bzang ba sga 'khor dang bcas pa/ mo gos legs pa/ bzo bo nyi shu po thams cad la gos lham ske rags tshun chad cha tshang ba re rnams sprad/ 'brel can rnams sngon du 'gro ba'i mkha' khyab kyi sems can thams cad bla na med pa'i byang chub myur du thob pa dang*/ gnas skabs su yang 'jig rten bde zhing*/ bstan pa spyi dang*/ khyad par du yang phyir mi ldog pa 'khor lo'i gtam dang ldan pa'i bstan pa rgyas par smon lam btab po/

/ dga' ston gyi gral 'di la/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis la bshad tshoms rgya che bar byas/ de rjes dgun la nye ba na/ chos rje bla brang 'gag pa byams pa kun dga' ba grwa btsun sum cu skor dang bcas pa chos zhu bar byung*/ tshogs chen la blo sbyong zhig bshad pa'i gzhug tsam la sleb pa yin/ rgyal chen bzhi'i logs bris kyi rab gnas/ gsang 'dus 'jam rdor la brten nas byas pa de kha'i steng nas/ khong dpon slob rnams la dbang zhig kyang bskur/ 'di skabs jo nang dbu mdzad pa'i jo jo 'das pa dang*/ khong tsho dpon slob tsho'i bsngo zhus gshin don mang po dbang yon dang gu chu rug byas pa'i gshin bsngo byed dgos dang*/ rlung drag po langs pa sogs rab gnas de rten 'brel legs rgyu ma byung*/ nai gu chos drug gi dmigs pa nges po zhig kyang bshad/ de rjes dgun khrid rim pas sngar lugs bzhin btsugs/ 'gag pa dpon slob thams cad kyis dam po yang rgyab/ shangs chos lhag ma rnams kyang cha tshang tsam byas/ 'di skabs gsang ba'i de kho na nyid kyi ṭīk+ka de brtsams pa yin te/ cung zad mkha' 'gro rnams kyi bka' ma grol ba'i rmi ltas zhig kyang byung*/ brel bas g.yengs nas tshogs gtor bshags pa sogs byed pa'ang ma byung*/ dam po grol nas bla ma byams pa kun dga' rang la sbyor drug gi yan lag phyi ma rnams kyi lag len 'dzug btsugs dang*/ ngo sprod rnams kyi go don zhib mor 'khrid dgos pa byung ste/ phyis blo la 'jags pa ni ma byung 'dugasngar gsang ba'i de kho na nyid kyi 'grel pa brtsams pa de'i gnyan cha dang khong la'ang sbyor drug gi lag len ston dgos byung ba'i gnyan cha sdoms pa 'dra ba cig gis rkyen byas te/ srog gegs kyi rnam pa shin tu na ba zhag bdun tsam byung*/ yongs gril ba nad gzhug de zla gcig lhag pa bsdad/ thur sel gsus par log pas dang kha 'gribs/ da dung yang de'i sred skabs re langs yong ba 'dugaspyir yan lag phyi ma rnams kyi lag len 'di shin tu bka' gnyan par 'dugakhyad par khong ba dang po sbyor drug gi chos la dad pa chen po mi 'dug pas/

de sel du song nas lan pa 'dra'o/ / de rjais dam rdzas ril bu zhig bsgrubs/ dam tshig gtsang ba rnams dang lhan cig tshogs dang gtor ma 'ga' re byas pas nad gzhug lhag ma de yang de skabs sangs pa 'dra ba zhig byung*/ 'di skabs dus khrid dkyus las zla gcig gi snga ba yod pas legs par byung*/ gzhan du na ba de chos sgang rang la yod pa 'dug cing*/ brel ba mang po dang yang thug pa cig ka yong ba 'dugargyal ba seng ge'i sku skye ri shing pa yang*/ khams phyogs la 'byon pa'i blo rtse byas 'dug kyang*/ 'bri gung tsam nas shin tu bsnyung ba'i tshur logs skyid shong brag dkar sker du gshegs 'dugadang po nged kyi brtag pa de bden par byung/ de rjes lug lo gsar ba hor zla dang po'i tshes bco lnga yan la/ sangs rgyas rabs bdun gyi nang nas bcom ldan 'das thams cad skyob dang*/ log par dad sel dang*/ gser thub dang/ 'od srung gi sku brnyan rnams kyang gzungs bzhugs phyin chad mtha' dag ma tshang ba med par grub/ dpal sangs rgyas thod pa dang*/ ye shes dbang phyug ma dang phyag rdor stod 'grel lugs kyi bde mchog ste/ dkyil 'khor gsum po de rim can du zhal phyi nas rab gnas tshar re byas/ 'di skabs sde srid dbus nas bsam 'grub rtser phebs de rgyang tsam song skabs yin/ rab gnas 'di tsam la yong ba yod zhu bar btang na/ rab ston gsher bar song dogs 'phrod ye ma phul na'ang*/ ma gi nas thugs tshod gnang ba dang 'grig ste/ rab ston mang ja sbrel ma/ tshar bzang pa/ dar 'gyed ja 'gyed/ nged la'ang g.yangs khre'u'i dam kha gcig sogs bzab ma dang*/ kun dga' dpal bzang la yang tsan dan dmar po'i rgya rtags gnang ba sogs dang*/ brda ma btang ba la skye bo mang po rang 'dus par tsam pa dang nged rang gi lag nas skya btsun thams cad la nas 'bo rgyag sogs mdor na/ thog ma'i rtsis la skabs 'dir rab gnas gsangs se byas/ dga' ston dang bcas pa'i rab gnas phyis byed snyam na'ang*/

'di skabs rang du dga' ston bzab rgyas rang shugs la byung*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs phyis bzhengs pa bzhi po 'di la/ zangs khal nyis brgya bdun cu skor/ gser zhog sum stong du nye ba/ rtsi rang la ti tsha khal gnyis tsam/ dngul zho dgu bcu lhag tsam/ sha dkar zho brgyad cu tsam dang bcas pa song*/ dga' ston thog yon rdzongs su/ bzo bo sngar gyi rnams la/ bkra shis kha btags kha bzhi bcu/ gser srang bzhi/ g.yu rna gnyis/ pho skor bzhi/ g.yu nyi shu/ dngul spyi gnyis/ dngul phor gnyis/ rten khebs bcu/ ma ṇi ma'i mthongs yod pa'i bla bre gcigabyus ser po yugasman tshe yug bco lnga/ gzhan dar yug bco lnga/ sman tshe'i yol ba gnyis/ sman tshe kha 'khyar brgya tham pa/ dar gzhan kha 'khyar sum brgya/ ja sig bzhi bcu/ bse sgam cha/ ka ci'i yol ba/ g.yas shag dang 'jong dar ma bu 'dres pa bco lnga/ gtsang snam dbu snam/ stod ras yug rnams bcu bcu/ kha sha spun 'dab/ ka yugagon chen/ gon chung rnams nyi shu nyi shu/ ras yug sum cu/ rta gcigadre'u gnyis/ sder spyad/ dkar yol ba ri la sogs pa nor sna phran bu sna tshogs dang bcas pa sbyin/ dga' ston snga phyi gnyis kar la/ bzo bo nyi shu po re re bzhin sman tshe tshon rdzogs ma kha mdud re yang legs dar gyi tshul du sprad/ sngar bzhin sku gzugs bzhengs pa la bya ba byas pa'i dge ba thams cad rang shar spros bral du ngo shes pa'i sgo nas bsngo bas 'phral du rgyas thebs par yang byas/ smon lam de dag 'grub par 'dug snyam pa'i nges shes kyang skye bar byung ngo*/ / rab gnas kyi sgang la nged la snga mo zhig chos du ma re thob zer ba'i rtogs ldan zhig rgya gar du phyin pa'i rdo rje gdan nas kyang rgyang tsam lhor phyin/ nged kyi bla ma gang ba'i rdo rjes bskur ba yin zer/ de bzhin gshegs pa mnyam bzhag mdzad pa'i rdo sku/ sngon rdo rje gdan gyi 'khyams kyi lha yin pa skyon med zhig khur nas nged la gtad/

nub phyogs nas ye shes sems dpa' dngos su byon pa'i rnam par 'dugagatsang khang chen mor ding phon bum gdan ma gser ma gsum gyis gtsos pa'i bum gdan ma bcu dgu'i bla bre dang*/ 'du khang chen mo'i ka ba sum cu so drug gi sa la khebs pa'i bla bre bzang sgrigs chen mo nyi shu rtsa bdun/ 'og min lha khang la dgu dang*/ rgya gar lha khang la kha thi dang byus yug sgrigs pa'i bla bre sogs kyang 'bul thub/ de nas lug lo'i hor zla gnyis pa'i nang du gtsang du sde srid rgyal bu'i drung khri thog tu phebs rgyu'i thog la/ nged la'ang 'bod mi phebs pa ltar tshes gnyis la rtag brtan nas bteg ste/ 'jad kyi ne sing du zhag gcig bsdad pa'i skabs/ nye skor de tsho nas 'phrad mkhan shin tu mang ba zhig byung*/ gser sdings su bsdad pa'i nub mo/ rgyal po gnas rnying pa'i cho 'phrul btsun gzhon bong ring shin tu mdzes pa/ 'khor ban de dang skyes pa bud med bzab chas can lnga bcu drug cus skor ba zhig byas de/ nged la phyag cig phul/ ja zhal cig drangs/ da res khyed yongs pa de nged la bkra shis/ sngar gyod kha che ba zhig yod pa nged rang sang 'gro ba 'dugagazhan thabs kyis phar yol tshur yol byas pa yin zer ba cig byung*/ tshes lnga'i nyin mo bsam rtser sleb/ de nyin sngar gyi rtogs ldan smyon pa des/ nged kyi rta gdong nas phar skyid la zer 'khrab kyin rgyugs/ rten 'brel 'tshub tsam du 'dug ste mngon 'gyur ni cang ma byung*/ 'gong po dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur du yong ba 'dugasleb 'phral nas zhag gsum gyi ring de la sku khrus dang*/ drag dbang tshe dbang sogs ci rigs pa phul/ tshes brgyad kyi snga thog gza' skar bzang ba la/ rgyal po rgyal rigs spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba'i tshogs/ khri thog tu 'jog pa'i mnga' gsol de phul/ sde srid rang yang snga gong stobs kyi rgyal po yin pas/ khri 'don ka dpe ma ma gnang bas/

dgongs bzhed ltar lhan du phul ba yin/ spyi babs bod kyi sde dpon phal cher rang 'tshams kyi rgyal srid 'dzin pa de srol yin pa 'duga'aga' zhig la che 'don byed pa'i srol 'dug kyang*/ shis brjod re tsam ma gtogs/ cho ga 'di byed kyi nges pa mi 'dug na'ang*/ 'phags yul na rgyal rigs dra ma rgyal srid du bsko ba la/ rig byed las 'byung ba'i cho ga 'dug pa de/ de dang rig pa mtshungs pa la/ cho ga nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i lugs su sbyar nas skabs 'dir byas pa lags/ de nas zhag mang po'i bar dga' ston rgya chen pos khyab par mdzad/ sgyu ma lta bu'i rtsed sna yang mang du mthong*/ mi 'tshogs dang grags pa ches pas 'dre mi ma yin mang po 'dus sam snyam pa 'dug/ de 'dras nad yams la sogs pa byung dogs 'dug pa nas/ 'byung po spyi gtor dang*/ bgegs gtor mang tsam btang bas/ so sor gyes pa'i rnam pa yang shar/ gzhan yang phyi nang gi rten 'brel yin 'dug pas/ rgyal srid kyi bya ba byed pa'i mi ma yin snga phyi las tshan brje ba'i rnam pas gsar pa mang po sleb/ rnying pa skrag mdangs gzi brjid can mang po laug 'gro ba'i rnam pa 'dugabud med zil can gcig sngar skyid po rang byung*/ da 'gro zer 'khor mang po dang bcas phyogs byang shar la song ba'i snang ba gsal bar byung*/ nyin mo mi 'tshogs che zhing*/ rtsed sna zang zing mang po dang*/ mtshan mo 'byung po'i zang zing mang pos dus 'das kyang*/ de thams cad 'dus byas mi rtag zag bcas sdug bsngal/ chos thams cad stong zhing bdag med pa'i tshul la nges shes skyed pa'i brda don kho nar byung bas/ ri khrod du bsdad pa las kyang nyams myong la bogs che ba tsam shar/ dga' ston gyi ring der/ sa chu dros pa rang zhig byung ba las/ de rjes cung zad bsil du song*/ zla ba de kha'i zla gzhug nas drag po'i gtor dbang 'dra yang phul/ zla ba dkar nas tshe dbang sogs thog mar rkyen sel la phul rjes/

dbang ngam rjes gnang sogs dbang chos rnam grangs re 'chag med dang*/ sde srid nyid kyi dgongs bzhed ltar/ mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi bshad pa'i chos thun re yang 'chag med du byas de/ 'dzin chos skyong ba dang*/ zin bris 'debs pa yang*/ 'di skabs thugs brel shin tu rang che ba'i skabs su 'dug kyang*/ 'dzin chos dang*/ zin bris dang*/ mtha' gcod kyi bshad pa gsan pa sogs thugs rtsol shin tu che ba mdzad/ btsun pa kun la 'di 'dra'i 'dun pa byung na 'tshed pa gda' ste/ zhogs rgyugs re yang 'dzin mi nus/ spyi chos thun re yang nyan mi nus pa 'dis phung gda'/ sngon bstan pa dar bya ba yang/ btsun pa rnams 'dun pa che ba'i ming yin/ deng sang chos nub bya ba yang*/ chos pa rnams slob gnyer sgom sgrub gang la yang 'dun pa mi byed pa 'di la zer ba yin/ bod na btsan btsun mang nyung rang ta da lta yang lcogs tsam gda' ste/ grul btub de ye mi gda'/ sngon tshangs par spyod pa'i rab byung du ma zad/ dge bsnyen dang sngags pa dang*/ khyim btsun tshun chod kyang*/ dpe 'dri ba dang*/ lta rtog dang*/ bshor spyang dang*/ chos zhu ba dang*/ nyan shad sogs la rtsol ba can mang du byung zhing*/ sgom sgrub la yang rtsol ba che bar byung*/ bstan pa gnas pa bya ba de 'dra la zer ba yin par gda'/ thugs brel ches pas nyin mo chos gsan long mi yong 'dug pa/ chos bka' rnams mtshan mo'i ring kho na la mdzad de/ res 'ga' 'dzin chos grol ba na nam phyed yol la khad song ba yang yong gin 'dugazin bris phyag bris de'i rjes su mdzad pas/ tho rangs tsam du 'gro ba lan mang*/ 'di skabs byang zhabs drung nor khyung klu sdings nas yar ngam ring la phebs song ba'i skad cha tshor te/ ltas ni shin tu 'tshub par 'dugakhong rang la ni zhu mkhan ma btang*/ gzhan rnams la ni smras/ tshangs chug byung nas 'di yan chad du/ nged dang 'phrad dgos pa 'dug gsung ba zhig yang yang byung kyang*/

bzang brdzu'i zom zom de ka min pa/ bshags pa byed gsung pa lta bu'i kha gsal can gang yang mi 'dug pas/ nged kyis kyang zem 'gros la bzhag pa yin/ yang bar skabs su sangs rgyas thod pa dang*/ kyai rdor mtshon cha can dang*/ ye shes dbang phyug ma dang*/ bde mchog mai tri bcu gsum ma'i dbang sogs byas/ klu sdings gsar ba la sngar chu thags shar zer ba/ bkra shis dge 'phel du ming spos pa yin/ da yang dge ba 'phel ba de mi dga' bsam ming 'dra min cig 'dugagazims khang gi rab gnas sogs la nged yon mchod lhan du phebs zhag gnyis bzhugs/ de rjes phyag tu 'byor pa'i thags sku'i rigs dang*/ se'u sogs tshem sku'i rigs/ si thang gsar rnying*/ gzhan yang thang ka'i rigs shin tu mang ba dang*/ bka' 'gyur hor par ma/ grub thob brgyad cu'i zhal thang gsar bzhengs/

'bur sku yang rgya bod sna tshogs pa mang po dang bcas pa la/ sa ga'i zla ba'i tshes bco lnga'i nyin rab gnas rgyas par byas/ zhag bdun gyi bar du mchod pa rgya chen po gnang ba sogs bshad tshod dang mthun par mdzad/ 'bras spungs dga' ldan pho brang ba'i nang zan 'ga' zhig dang rgya le ba'i bud med rnams la'ang btson dong du 'jug pa sogs bka' skyon par byung yang ngo chen zhus pas bde bar khrol/ g.yor por sil ma dang 'da' 'u nang nas sde pa gzhung gi phyag tu gang byung rnams nged la mchod gzhis su sbyor 'jags gnang*/ blon chen bde skyid par bka' skyon 'gangs che ba rang byung na'ang*/ zhu ngo gang drag zhus pas/ gnyer kha bzhes pa min pa de res la nyes skyaun gzhan ma byung ba yin/ zla ba lnga pa'i tshes bzhi la yar btegachu byang rgyud byas de lam 'gol zhing skyid pa'i ngang nas/ tshe brgyad kyi snga thog rtag brtan du sleb/ bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas dpa' bo bdun gyi rab gnas zhal dro chen mo de/ zla ba de ka la byas na phyogs nas yong mkhan rnams dus thug ste mi 'choms par 'dug pas/ hor zla drug pa'i yar tshe dge ba cig la byed par byas de bar du chos than thun 'dra bshad/ byang nas zhabs drung shin tu sku bsnyel ba'i sku rim la dgon yar mar du mang ja dang*/ nged la'ang da res bshags pa 'bul ba yin pas/ ngam ring du yong dgos gsung ba byung ba na'ang*/ bshags pa ni len par spro yang yar phyogs 'gro ni ma thub/ sku rim de la'ang sel gyi rnam pa yod nges shes pa'i 'u lag pa mi gsum la skyon par byung*/ sger pa rje drung rtogs ldan pa 'byor pa la yang*/ khong gis sngar ma thob pa'i shangs chos kyi 'phro 'dra rim pas bshad/ ri khrod chen por sgrub sde la/ thugs rje chen po'i smar khrid dang*/ spyan ras gzigs kyi rjes gnang gi rigs mang tsam byas/ gting skyes nas sde pa rgyal bu'i drung dang chos rje ye shes rgya mtsho ba dpon sa yum sogs kyang rab gnas kyi dga' ston dang legs ja gnang bar phebs/

tshes brgyad kyi nyin gza' skar sogs 'grub sbyor bzang ba la/ dpal he ru ka 'khor lo sdom pa ngag gi dbang phyug 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor zhal phye nas rab gnas dngos gzhi sgrubs/ de'i nang par rab gnas rjes kyi bya ba rnams byas/ 'ja' 'od dang me tog gi char 'bab pa nyi ma bstud mar byung ba sogs phyi ltas nang ltas thams cad legs par byung*/ rang re'i lag nas btang ba dang*/ phyogs kyi zur 'dren sogs dga' ston nyin zhag mang po 'brel ba la/ rtag brtan rang gi tshogs pa dngos rnams 'du khang chen mo khengs pa dang*/ sgrub sde rnams gzhal yas khang gi khyams su 'tshog sa mdzad/ de min rang re la gtogs pa'i dgon tha dad pa'i grwa btsun sna tshogs pa rnams chos bzang gi rdo bcal du 'tshogs/ de la su 'dod yongs chog pa'i tshogs yangs par byas/ yongs gril ba la haṃ rgyag tsam ma yin par re re nas bgrangs pa la/ ser mo ba'i khul du stong phrag gsum lhag bcas la/ nyin re bzhin mang ja gang thongs thongs dang*/ tsha gro mar thud/ 'khur ba sogs dang dga' ston dngos gzhi'i nyin bur bsgar mtho gru bzhi/ rtsam nas khal 'gyed/ dngos po'i phyag 'gyed bzab pa dang*/ gzhan gting skyes nas zhal ngo re res mang ja 'gyed bcas te/ gzhan yang grwa rigs mchod gzhis kyi khul nas zur 'dren dga' ston gyi 'bul ba sogs rnam grangs mang ba dang*/ mchod gzhis pas gtsos pa'i stod smad thams cad nas 'dus pa'i skye bo'i tshogs dga' ston len pa dang*/ rten mjal bar 'ongs pa ches tshogs che bar 'dus pa rnams la gro bzhes/ chang gang 'thung*/ bu ram 'khyid gru bzhi nas 'bo sogs dga' ston rgya khyon che zhing byings chags pa 'thab rtsod sogs nyes skyon ye med pa'i 'jam pa rang cig byung*/ de mtshams ye shes sems dpa' dngos su byon pa'i phyi rtags sku'i byin phebs pa'i rten 'brel du/ chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan gyi thugs dam thub pa'i rdo sku 'di/

bla ma sman chu bas spyan drangs te 'dir byon/ phyis kyi ma phyi sogs dgon pa'i spyi thes su dgongs nas sde srid kyis bka' 'gyur yongs rdzogs zhig gnang ba yang dga' ston thog ma'i nyin 'byor ba/ gsung chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i rten 'brel 'grig cing*/ gsung rdo rje'i ye shes phebs par nges shes skyes/ bar skabs der sher snying gi 'grel ba chung ba dang*/ che ba de yang sum gnyis tsam zhig bris thub/ 'di skabs byang zhabs drung yang zla ba drug pa'i tshes bdun la sku gshegs pa'i skabs 'dir bsngo rten dang*/ sku byang cig kyang gcog dgos bar byung ba lugs gnyis kar nas 'brel ba shin tu che bas sku sgrib sbyangs thabs de skyo shas dang 'brel ba cig gi ngang nas/ dmigs su gang 'gro snying thag par byas/ cung zad phan thogs par mngon pa cig byung*/ 'di skabs kyang gtsang sde srid nas g.yu rtse sa ri sa skor thams cad thog ma mdzod pa kun dga' dpal bzang la gnang ba yin na'ang*/ rtag brtan du rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub mchod thes bstan pa nam gnas sbyor ba gnang*/ de rjes rtag brtan gyi dbyar chos la dpal 'khor lo bde mchog lū hi pa'i lugs kyi rdzogs rim rnal 'byor chen po dril bu pa'i khrid rim pa lnga pa/ nag po rim bzhi lam slong chen mo/ dpyal lugs kyi phag mo sgom drug gi 'khrid/ rtsa dbu ma'i khrid/ nā ro mkha' spyod kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i khrid/ bde mchog dkar po'i byang chub sgrub lam gyi 'khrid dang tshe khrid gnyis/ bde mchog lhan skyes kyi khrid/ ma hā mā ya'i khrid/ sangs rgyas thod pa'i khrid/ rdo rje gdan bzhi'i khrid de ma rgyud kyi khrid rnam grangs mi 'dra ba khungs dang ldan pa bcu gcig dang*/ o la pa ti'i 'grel pa rang nyid kyis sbyar ba de ka'i steng nas/ lung dang bshad pa rgyas pa tshar gcigatshe mdo'i 'grel pa'i bshad pa dang lung rnams byas/

de nas hor zla dgu pa'i stod la gting skyes nas sde pa ma chen yang gnas mjal dang nged 'phrad par phebs/ sgrub sde chos sde gnyis char du/ mang ja 'gyed bcas rnam gzhag bsngo rten sogs khyad par can sgrub par mdzad/ tshe dbang rigs gnyis brgya rtsa dang*/ rkyen sel gyi rjes gnang ci rigs pa dang 'khor lo bde mchoganag po lugs kyi dbangadang*/ rnal 'byor ma'i byin rlabs sogs gsan/ dus ston gzhung yin kyang dgun chos dang sbrags pa la/ bde mchog 'khrul spong dang*/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang*/ sdom pa 'byung ba dang*/ 'khor lo sgyur drug dang*/ sbyangs pa'i yon tan ma dang*/ dril bu lha lnga dang*/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje dang*/ bong zhal can dang*/ phyag rdor stod 'grel lugs kyi rtsa dkyil dang phag mo lha so bdun ma ste bde mchog yab yum du gtogs pa'i dbang bka' bcu po de rnams tshogs pa thams cad la bskur/ gting skyes nas sde pa'i drung gis kyang de thams cad zhor la gsan/ de nas bar skabs der ri khrod chen mor mtshams zhag bcu skor zhig byas/ rang re bsam 'grub rtse nas 'khor ba nas gzung 'di bar du/ sgo khang gi logs bris chos skyong bco lnga 'khor dang bcas pa dang*/ gtsang khang gi logs bris dpal dus kyi 'khor lo dang dpal 'khor lo sdom pa dang*/ rdo rje 'jigs mdzad la sogs pa sngags sku gtso che ba'i logs bris yongs rdzogs dang*/ 'jam dbyangs lha khang gi logs bris 'phros dang*/ o rgyan mkha' spyod lha khang gi logs bris phyed tsam dang*/ sman bla lha khang gi skya ris tsam gzhi sdod kyi lha ris pa rnams kyis grub pa yin/ dbon po bsod nams sogs kyis phyag rdor lha khang gi gyang ris grub cing*/ gnod sbyin nor lha'i lha khang gi skya ris tsam thebs so/ / ngang pa'i rgyal po'i rnam pa can gyi gru shan bzang po cig kyang 'gro ba rnams 'khor ba'i chu bo las sgrol ba mtshon byed du legs par btsugs/

bal po bzo bo bdun tsam gyis lugs sku than thun mang rab dang*/ gtso bo bcom ldan 'das kyi rgyab yol 'od skor/ rgyu gser zangs dngul gsum las grub pa sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs bcu gcig gis mdzes par byas pa/ 'phra rgyan khyad par can du mas yongs su spras pa 'di bzhengs thub/ mchod rdzas kyi khyad par mchod rkong chen mo dang*/ rting chen mo'i rigs 'ga' re yang bcos/ ri logs kyi spyil bu rnams gtso bor gyur pa'i spyil po bzhi bcu skor thebs/ gzhan yang las ka grub che bar byung*/ las mi nyung yang las mi mang po'i dus dang 'dra ba rang byung ngo*/ / 'di skabs gcig la lung nag shel dkar du tshur gyi mthu bzlog dang phar la drag las gnyis kar yin rgyu'i khungs kyis sgram sgram sil sil mang pau zhig byas pa'i grub 'bras la/ dpon mo de gza' gdong thug byung nas glo bur du 'das/ bsngo rten skyel mkhan byung bas/ nged kyis kyang ma legs skyel bzab pa zhig byas/ de nas sngar khyud ltar dgun gyi 'khrid kyang btsugs/ rta lo lug lo'i dgun khrid 'di gnyis la/ rtag brtan dang ri khrod kyi chos mnyam por tshugs pa de ni ma thub/ 'di lo sde pa bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis dam po mdzad pa yin zhing*/ skyes rgyal grwa rigs dam po byed mkhan shin tu mang bar byung*/ chos rje ye shes rgya mtsho ba la 'di ras snga phyir lam 'bras kyi gdams ngag yongs su rdzogs pa dang*/ nai gu'i khrid dang byin rlabs cha tshang ba zhig dang*/ ma hā mā ya'i rgyud kyi bshad pa zhib mo smon lam rnam gsum la rang re'i ṭī ka'i steng nas bshad pa 'dzug khrid/ bka' babs bdun ldan gyi gzhung gi bshad pa phyed tsam dang*/ man ngag yang de tsam bshad/ rgyud sde lnga dang kun rig la sogs pa'i dbang bskur yang byas/ skabs 'dir sher snying ṭīka chen gyi 'phros kyang rdzogs par bris pa yin/ dus khrid grol nas mtshams dam po rgyang tsam cig kyang byas/

smon thang mkhan chen brag dkar chos rje yang glo bo dang se rib phyogs kyi grwa rgyun gsar pa dang bcas legs par 'byor/ mkhan chen lhun rab pas dgos med la dge rgan tsho la ngan slob zhal ta dngos su bcuga'adir yong mkhan grwa pa lnga tsam gzhan la skyogs 'dugade nas glo bo ba tshos mang ja 'gyed bcas bsngo rten rnam gzhag sogs bzab rgyas su byung*/ yang 'di skabs mchod gtor bshams shing gsol ba btab pas legs pa'i mtshan ma yang byung zhing*/ khyad par 'phags ba 'jam dpal gyis gnang ba bstsal ba'i rmi ltas cig kyang byung nas/ gsang 'dus rim lnga la ṭīk+ka zhib pa 'di brtsams pa yin/ 'di 'bri ba la nyi ma nyi shu rtsa lnga song*/ skabs 'dir mdog smon 'gro ba'i rgyal bu tshe dbang lhun grub pa yang*/ bsam 'grub rtse'i zhol du rkyen drag po thog babs kyis glo bur du 'das 'dug pas/ bsngo rten du yi dam chos skyong gi sku 'ga' zhig byung*/ a phas bu la dug btang ba yin zer ba'i gtam ni 'dugagal te min na bka' chad rang yin/ de rjes byang nas dpon sa'i drung la gting skyes nas yab yum rnams kyis kyang ngo chen mdzad pa sogs nas/ bshags pa kha gsal mdzad de phebs/ sde gnyis su mang ja rnyed bkur sogs mdzad/ cung zad 'tshub cha yod pa gcig ka ni byung*/ sun 'byin ba'i stobs dang*/ slar bzlog pa'i stobs ni yod yod mi 'dra/ phyi ltar mdzes cha'i dbang du gda'o/ / de mtshams rgyal rtse bla ma'i zhabs drung dang mdog chos 'khor sgang gi slob dpon dang*/ gzhan dge bshes 'ga' shas dang*/ khyad par skabs 'dir/ smon thang nas mkhan chen brag dkar chos rje'i drung yang dbus 'khor nas phebs pa sogs don gnyer mang dag gcig la/ phyag rgya chen po gzhum dmigs pa gang nges nges dang*/ gzhan yang lam khyer 'chi med/ mkha' spyod sogs shangs chos phran tshegs rnams dang*/ bla ma'i drung dang smon thang mkhan chen gnyis la/ mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i phyi sgrub nang sgrub kyi lung khrid rnams yongs su rdzogs par byas/

'di skabs lung nag shel dkar ba gsar pa nang so rgya gan pa rnams dbang thang khas drag dpung pa yod 'phro rang de/ ja sbyor gcig gi sgang la thams cad sdib cing zhig pa'i rmi lam rmi 'phro la gnyid sad pa 'dra ba de byung ba'i skabs yin/ rkyen 'dis spyir stod smad kyi mang po zhig la sdib stong dang*/ khyad par snga sor byang gi mnga' zhabs su gtogs pa shas che ba'i khul nas/ bla ma slob dpon dgon sde rigs dpon skya che chung mang po zhig la/ re ba 'bras med dang byas pa mdo med byung*/ cha gcig nas blo brtad pas chog sar mi gtod/ log min gyi mgo brtod dang*/ ci min gyi rgyu 'grul rim po khog ngan blo nyes de tshol mkho yang mkho bar gda'/ de rjes gzhan yang smon thang mkhan chen sogs la chos sna than thun mang dag bshad/ dbang ldan lha khang*/ 'bar 'dzin lha khang gzhal yas khang rnams kyi logs bris tshugs shing*/ bka' 'gyur bzheng ba'i yig mkhan phal cher sleb/ yig gra yang tshugs/ snga sor dgun nas brtsams te nam dus dga' lod la ma ltos par/ zab chen gyi sku bcom ldan 'das dam tshig gsum bkod lha lnga lha mgron 'od dpag med/ bcom ldan 'das sman pa'i rgyal po dpangs su thog so bcu gcig gi rtsis chu zhing gab cing*/ kha thi dang byus sogs shas che ba'i rgyu tshogs bzang por bcas pa 'di yang skabs der legs par grub/ thog mar gtsug lag khang du zhal phye nas rab gnas bgyis shing*/ de rjes zla ba gsum pa'i tshes bco lnga la gtsug lag khang gi shar phyogs la bkram ste phyag mchod bzab pa zhig byas/ chos sde/ sgrub sde skye bo'i tshogs shin tu mang ba dang bcas pa la rten mjal btang*/ de nub gang che ba babs/ rgyal khams dkar por gyur pa'i rten 'brel dang*/ chos bdag mo mnyes pa'i cho 'phrul du'ang gda'/ de'ang dam tshig gsum bkod 'di bya rgyud kyi rtsa ba lta bu yin na'ang*/ tha na 'di'i bris thang tsam yang dkon par 'dug pas/

sku bzhengs pa sogs kyi mig ltos la phan nam snyam pa dang*/ rang yang lhag par 'di la mos shing*/ gzhan yang 'di ni sems bskyed kyi sdom pa thob/ sngags kyi dbang bskur ma thob pa rnams kyis kyang bzlas brjod byar rung zhing*/ gtsang sbra ma byas kyang gtsang sbrar 'gyur ba dang*/ tshul khrims dang mi ldan yang*/ tshul khrims dang ldan par 'gyur ba dang*/ dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa'ang dkyil 'khor du zhugs par 'gyur ba sogs phyi ma'i dus kyi sems can la shin tu phan thogs che ba zhig yin par gsung pas de'i dbang du byas pa lags/ de la ngaid kyis sogs 'grul dang*/ 'bul sdung gtong ba dang*/ tshong pa gtong ba sogs ni ye ma byas/ sde srid gtso bor gyur pa'i gzhan thams cad nas ci rigs ci rigs byung ba'i dar zab kyi rigs bung bas me tog gi tshogs las sbrang rtsi thob pa ltar byung ba rnams la bzhengs pa yin/ ma byin par blangs pa dang*/ g.yo sgyu khram gsum rku 'phrog skyis gsum sogs mi 'os pa'i rdzas gang dang yang ma 'dres pas dge ba gtsang dag kho na yin zhing*/
