de kas byin rlabs kyang che bar bdog go / de rjes lha khang so sor 'jim bzo ci rigs pa yang 'go tshugs shing*/ gtsang sa nas sde srid yar dgas phyogs la dpung 'degs su nye ba'i skabs/ sde srid zhabs drung nas khor tsam yong dgos gsung ba'i 'bod mi gnang byung ba/ tshes gcig la btegs/ lam thams cad du kha ba chen bo 'bab pa dang*/ khyad par bo dong bkra shis sgang nas gsing ma'i bar la nyin zang gis kha ba chen po babs/ 'di skabs lung nag gi rdzong bsgyel tshugs 'dugasgang dgu skyong dgu'i smad der rgya gan pa'i nang so bsam 'grub byon/ sde srid du ngo chen dgos tshul du 'dugatshes gsum la gzhis ka rtser 'byor zhing*/ bsu ba la sde srid bkra shis dge 'phel du phebs 'dugarta dar dang rol mo sogs kyis sna drangs te pho brang du 'byor/ de nyin nas ka chos bka'i 'go btsugs dpung thog tu phebs rgyu'i thugs brel gyi nyin mtshan 'khor yug tu 'brel 'gro ba 'dug kyang*/ bar chad sel phyogs kyi dbang rjes gnang rnams gsan pa la/ thugs rtsol ni cher gnang*/ kha char chen po 'bab pa dang*/ rlung cher g.yo ba sogs cho 'phrul du yang mngon pa dang*/ phyi rtags nang rtags legs nyes 'dres ma dang bcas tshes bcu gsum la dpung thog tu phebs song*/ nged la sde srid rgyal bu'i drung du dbang bka' sogs 'bul ba dang*/ gang ci'i khyad tsam 'dug pas/ 'gyangs tsam sdod dgos phebs pa ltar zla 'phro de bsdad/ smon thang mkhan po dang*/ gzhan yang rab 'byams pa 'ga' re sogs phyag phyir dkris pa'i sde srid rgyal bu'i drung du gsang ba 'dus pa ye shes zhabs lugs kyi dbang*/ sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang*/ rgya gzhung gi lung dang bcas pa sogs chos kyi rnam grangs 'ga' re phul/ de dus rten 'brel legs mdog kha mo yod/ lar 'go ma rten 'brel legs kyang*/ rkyen gyis log 'gro ba la tshegs mi gda'/ yang zhol na thor pa cung zad 'dug pas dpon sa a lce'i drung la phyil bsangs na rang legs zhus na'ang*/

zhabs drung dpa' bo dang bla ma sogs bzlog pa'i 'brum srung la gdeng mdzad nas gseng ba ni ma mdzad/ 'di skabs ngur smṛg gi sgrol ma rdzong 'dzin 'di na phebs 'dug pas spyan 'dren zhus/ mchod pa phul/ gsol ba mang du btab/ bar chad mang po sel ba dang*/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i ltas kyang cung zad byung*/ lan cig rmi lam du 'phags ma nyid yin snyam pa'i mi'i tshul can gzhon nu ma rgyan gyis brgyan pa zhig nam mkhar byung*/ phyis lo shas rmi lam du dpal ldan sham bha la yin snyam pa yang yang byung bas/ sngar gyi las 'gyur nas/ der skye ba len pa yin nam snyam tsa na/ de min brtsams chos rnams sham bha la'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi gsung dang mthun bar byung bas/ de'i rten 'brel gyi yin gsung ba cig byung*/ hor zla lnga pa'i tshes bdun la byang chen du sleb tsam byas/ 'jam dbyangs tshul bzang ba grib kyi rnam pas khams ngan par 'dug cing*/ phya bka' bcu pa yang bsnyung gzhi brdzi bar 'dug pa/ nged kyis sbyang ba dang rnam 'joms kyi byabs bkrus tsam bgyis pas khong pa gnyis po'ang myur du khams dwangs/ de nas yar lam 'gor med du 'ongs/ brag ram du yang khor tsam phyin pa'i gnod sbyin la gtor ma bzab pa cig phul/ tshes bcu gnyis la rtag brtan du sleb/ zhag shas ni brel g.yengs 'dra la song*/ nyer bzhi nas brtsams te dbyar kha spyi chos la/ shangs chos yongs rdzogs kyi dbang du byas te dpal rgyud sde lnga chab gcig tu sgrubs pa'i dbang bde mchog lha lnga'i dbang sogs chos drug bka' bcu/ phyag chen bka' lnga/ mkha' spyod bka' lnga/ phag mo gsang sgrub/ spyan ras gzigs skyer sgang lugs kyi bka' gsum/ rnam 'joms/ phyag rdor mi g.yo ba'i bka' sogs dbang bka' rags rim phal che ba dang*/ chos drug phyag chen lam 'khyer 'chi med/ su kha'i skor gyi 'khrid/ thugs rje chen po skyer sgang lugs kyi 'khrid/

rjes su yi rang gi bar du 'khrid kyi skor dang*/ nai gu su kha ra hu la/ rdo rje gdan pa rnams kyi man ngag so so dang*/ thugs rje chen po'i skor dang*/ gcod rin chen 'phreng ba sogs dpe lung rnams kyang cha tshang bar song*/ khams pa rab 'byams pa blo gros bstan 'dzin dang*/ kong rab pa dkon mchog dpal bzang sogs kyi gsol ba btab pa'i ngor/ gzhan don gnyer bzhi bcu tsam/ rgyal rtse bla ma zhabs drung dang bcas pa rnams la lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdams ngag cha lag dang bcas pa yongs su rdzogs pa dang*/ lam skor phyi ma brgyad kyi bklags lung dang bcas pa bshad/ lar dbus nas 'khor ba'i stag lo de nas gzung*/ phyogs nas yongs pa shas che ba'i don gnyer nyung bsdus nyung bsdus la/ lam 'bras cha tshang re lo re bzhin bshad dgos pa byung*/ dbyar gung yan chad la de bzhin gshegs ba drug po rnams kyi sku'i rgyab yol gser zangs dngul gsum las byas shing*/ phra rgyan du mas spras pa rnams kyang grub/ rgyab yol bdun po rnams la zangs khal brgya drug cu tsam/ byugs gser zho bzhi brgya/ dngul zho sum brgya tsam song*/ rtsi'i chas la sogs pa yang des dpag par nus so/ / rgyab yol rnams kyi 'phra'i rgyu la'ang*/ brdar shel rdog po che ba nyi shu rtsa gcigachung ba drug brgya skor/ g.yu che chung 'dres pa lnga brgya dang brgyad bcu/ phug skor sog sna me togardo rje sogs che chung 'dres pa bzhi bcu zhe bzhi la sogs pa dang*/ rin po che'i khyad par ci rigs pa'ang song*/ yang sngar gyi zab sku'i 'phros las 'o skol gyi ston pa'i sku brnyan 'khor rgyal po zla ba bzang po'i sprul gzhi phyag na rdo rje dang*/ rigs ldan grags pa'i sprul gzhi 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ spyan ras gzigs kyi rnam sprul kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po sogs kyis bskor ba/ dpangs phal thog bdun gyi rtsis su byas pa 'di yang*/ hor zla bdun pa'i zla stod kyi nang du legs par grub/

rtag brtan nyid du rab gnas byas shing skya ser thams cad la rten mjal yang btang*/ de bzhin du kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po dus gsum sangs rgyas dol po pa'i sku brnyan mda' gang ma gnyis bzhengs pa'i sku re re la zangs khal gnyis re dang*/ gnyis kar sdoms pa'i phyug gser la/ gser zho bzhi bcu zhe lnga tsam song ba/ gnyis kar shin tu mtshar ba rab gnas byas pa tsam gyis byings chags par byung*/ hor zla bdun pa'i nyer gsum gza' skar dge ba la/ byang chub chen po'i zab sku dang*/ kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po'i sku 'dra gcig ri khrod chen por bsu pa'i bkod ba dang bcas ste spyan drangs pas/ me tog gi char shin tu che ba 'bab pa dang*/ phyogs thams cad dri bzang gis khyab pa sogs phyi rtags dang*/ sgom chen rnams la ye shes lhag par phebs pa sogs byin rlabs kyi rtags mtshan shin tu che ba byung*/ de skabs dbus nas sde srid kyi bka' shog don la/ zhabs drung rgyal bu'i drung du 'brum pa byung dogs sogs 'dug kyang*/ zhu lan du dang lo'i res la mi yong ba 'dra zhus/ sgrub sde rnams la sum pa lo ts+tsha ba'i blo sbyong zhig bshad/ rtag brtan du mi ngan lag len nyes pa'i gdung chen gas pa dang*/ logs ris kyi sra rtsi sdib pa sogs ci rigs byung*/ yon bdag la lta bar 'dugasgam po sku skye ba'i drung yang chos ci rigs gsan par phebs pa tshogs chos de yang gsan/ zur du bya rgod shongs nas sku skye rin po che'i drung dang*/ gzhan rab 'byams pa gnyis gsum dang lhan cig tu sgrol ma nyer gcig nyi ma sbas pa'i lugs kyi rjes gnang dang*/ rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i dbang sogs gsan song*/ de rjes mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug rwa lo chen po'i thugs dam rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi thang sku yang lag tu byung*/ lo 'di la 'jigs mdzad kyi sku ster mkhan gzhan yang mang du byung ngo*/ /

dbyar ston sbrags pa de la rang re'i chos gzhis tshor dpon sa a lce'i drung gis zer gsog yang yang mdzad/ mi sna tshos sde srid kyi bka' shog la yang rtsi rgyu med/ a lce drung gi bka' shog ston dgos zer ba sha stag byung*/ rten 'brel log pa'i rtags su gda'o/ / yang sgrub thabs kun las btus pa'i grangs bshad pa zhes bya ba/ paṇ+ḍi ta dpal 'dzin sdes mdzad ces pa cig gi rgya dpe 'khyams po zhig snga mo nas lag tu 'byor pa de sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'i dkar chag tu 'dugade'i rim pa dang bstun na/ yar klung lo tsā ba grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi bsgyur bar mdzad pa 'di la bar bar na rgya dpe khol 'don du song ba'i ma tshang ba mang tu yod ces sngar grags 'dug pa ltar don la gnas par 'dug cing lo grags nyid kyi bsgyur ba'i skabs la yod pa la yang*/ bod dpe nyid la zegs pa ci rigs pa'ang byung ste/ dper na stobs po che'i sgrub thabs gnyis bya ba las/ zhal gsum phyag drug pa'i sgrub thabs 'gyur gsar 'thor bas/ sngar gyi 'gyur rnying bcug pa lta bus mtshon/ da lta yang de dpe kha cig la yod/ la la la med do/ / des na dkar chag dang bstun na sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'i rgya gzhung deng sang yod pa 'di na sgrub thabs shin tu mang ba zhig ma chug 'dug pas rang res sngar nas yang yang rtsol ba byas te brtags shing btsal ba na/ sngar bod du 'gyur zin pa yang med du snang la/ 'ga' zhig sgrub thabs rgya mtsho na yod pa de dang mdzad pa po gcig mi gcig mi shes pa re re gnyis gnyis la/ don gcig pa rnams tshad mar bzhag thar pa nas sgrub thabs sngar ma 'gyur ba'i rgya dpe mang du rnyed byung ba/ de dag rgya dpe'i steng nas bsgyur/ ston de dag rnams phyogs gcig tu sgrigs pa grub par byas/ bka' rgyun med kyang glegs bam bzhugs tshul la gal che bar 'ong*/ yang dngul las grub pa'i thor tshugs dpog zhu dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs mtshon pa'i lha bcu dgu'i sku gzugs can rin po che'i rigs sna tshogs dang*/

mtha' gnas mu tig mang po sogs phra rgyan du mas brgyan pa shin tu legs ba gcig kyang bzhengs/ de nas hor zla dgu pa'i tshes nyi shu gsum gza' skar bzang ba la bka' 'gyur ro 'tshal gyi glegs bam ma lus pa glegs shing dang bcas pa tshangs 'grig tu bzhengs tshar/ rtsi gras kyang grub pa'i dga' ston yon rdzongs su/ yig mkhan lnga bcu nga lnga la/ bkra shis kha btags bcu/ bzang dar kha nyis brgya/ kha btags sum cu/ ja sig bcu/ bur btang bcu/ dong pa gser shog ma drug rta cham bzhi/ rta sga legs pa lnga/ rag shas/ dung chas/ mdob chas sdoms pa bdun/ tim pi sbal pa sogs nor sna phran bu rnam grangs mang ba/ g.yas shag gser shog ma bcu/ gon chen gon chung spun 'dab ras yugasnam bu cob ras yug tshangs rnams so sor brgya dang bcu bcu/ bal mang po dang*/ rta na gzhon bzang ba gnyis/ bong bu sga gdan dang bcas pa bcu gsum/ ba lang bcu/ spu nag brgyad cu gya brgyad so sor sman tshe'i kha mdud re dang bcas pa yod/ rje btsun 'phags pa dzam+bha la ser po'i sku brnyan/ rgyu gser zangs dngul gsum las grub pa phra rgyan rin po che sna tshogs pas brgyan pa/ bzo bkod 'phags yul gyi lugs su byas pa 'di la/ sku rgyu la zangs khal bdun tsam/ gser zho lnga bcu mi 'chad tsam/ rtsi sogs dgos cha de dang 'tshams par song*/ 'phra'i rgyu la g.yu'i rdo rje gnyis/ lo 'dab gnyis gzhan g.yu 'phra legs pa brgya dang bcu gcigame tog drugapad 'dab gnyis/ rin po che su kan+ti che ba gcigahak+ki bdun/ tsu ni bzhi bcu gzhan mu men byu ru mu tig sogs mang po dang bcas pa yod/ nyer bdun nyer brgyad la gzungs bzhugs dang thog ma'i rab gnas bgyis/ de rjes gser zhal gsol/ spyan 'byed phul nas/ hor zla bcu pa'i tshes gnyis lhag pa lag sor gyi 'grub sbyor bzang ba la slar yang rab gnas byas/ shing thog gsar ba 'bul ba sogs dang*/ longs spyod khyad par can 'phel ba'i rten 'brel gzhan yang mang du byung*/

bal po bzo bo bdun gyis rgyab yol bdun/ kun mkhyen chen po'i sku 'dra gnyis/ dzam bha la sogs phyis bzhengs pa rnams la/ bkra shis kha btags bdun bcu/ gser srang gang/ bzang ja sig bcu/ shal pa dkar dmar phring phra/ yang shal pa dkar po che ba/ sman tshe/ tshon rdzogs kha brgya lnga bcu/ sman tshe dkyus ma kha drug cu/ tshon si kha brgya dang sum cu/ dar yug bzang ba brgyad/ gos mtshal kha yug sne tshang*/ spun 'dab lnga bcu/ gon ma brgya dang bcu/ ras yug sum cu/ ka yug nyi shu/ snam bu bcu/ gos lham cha tshang bdun/ 'bras btang bur btang*/ 'jong dar sogs phran bu mang bo dang bcas pa'i yon rdzongs byas/ yon rdzongs dang sku rgyu'i rags rim bris pa 'di nga ser sna langs pa min/ nga rgyal skyes pa'ang min/ yus 'tshong ba'ang min/ phyis rten bzhengs mkhan rnams kyis 'di bzhin byed dgos bya ba'i don yin/ dbang che ltag khur gyi rten bzhengs de don med do zer rgyu yin/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i rgyud la gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rjes rnam bshad mdzad pa'i lugs kyi sgrub thabs zhig kyang bris/ sngar sgrub thabs 'phreng du sgrigs pa'i nang du chud par byas/ 'di yan chad la nor lha lha khang*/ dbang ldan lha khang*/ 'bar 'dzin lha khang*/ mkha' spyod lha khang*/ pad ma bkod pa'i lha khang*/ gzhal yas khang gi khyams chen mo rnams kyi logs bris grub par byas/ theg mchog lha khang du grub thob brgyad cu'i logs ris bris/ kun gzigs lha khang du 'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa na dang*/ bde ba can du 'od dpag med dang*/ lcang lo can du gsang bdag dang*/ o rgyan mkha' spyod du rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang*/ theg mchog tu dpal he ru ka dang*/ dga' ldan du byams pa dang*/ 'bar 'dzin du mi g.yo ba dang*/ drang srong me lha/ dbang ldan du gshin rje gshed nag po/ dpal chen du dpal 'khor lo bde mchog zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa rnams 'bul skur bzhengs thub cing*/

mngon spyod drag po'i lha khang du dpal nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po dang*/ ye shes mgon po phyag drug pa dang*/ phyag bzhi pa'i sku brnyan rnams bzhengs/ so sor rab gnas kyang 'phral 'phral bgyes/ phyi ma gnyis min pa thams cad la tshon yang btang grub pa'i skabs yin/ kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po'i sku 'dra khru tshad tsam dang*/ mda' tshad tsam pa nyi shu rtsa lnga/ de las cung zad chung ba nyi shu tsam dang bcas pa sngar rim can du bzhengs pa rnams la tshon rtsi gzungs bzhugs/ rab gnas kyi bar du grub/ lo 'di la mkhar las ni/ dpyid sos ka lho gling gi g.yas cung zad ngoms che sa gcig 'dug pa 'dir/ 'og nas ri 'gros kyang mang po bsdur/ dka' las mang po byas te/ zab sku 'grems sa cig rtsigs pa yin te/ nged gnyis po bsam 'grub rtser 'gro dgos byung ba des/ 'dir rngam po ba sogs 'go mi rnams kyang zhen mos gus sha tsha 'dod pa gang yang med pas nag chang la yengs nas las ka grub chung zhing*/

rtsig pa'i phyi'i mdzes cha legs legs tsam min pa/ nang hrom rtsigs su song chu 'gros sogs gang yang lhus ma things 'duganged mar phyogs zla gcig gi ring la gtor ma'ang 'gyangs pas lan nam/ dbyar stod de ser drag chen po zhig babs pa'i tho la rmangs nas 'gyel ba'i byas pa las ror song ba zhig byung*/ de mar bcad pa'i phyin chad shin tu grub che ste/ zab yangs kyi spe'u dang*/ phyi'i pang stegs lcags ri sogs legs par grub pa yin no/ / de la kho bo bsam pa bzang ba'i rten 'brel gyis/ dkar phyogs kyi lha rnams byams par byung ste/ mkhar las 'di'i dus kun tu sa rdo shing chu rnams gang 'dod du byung*/ rten sku bzhengs pa'i cha rkyen rnams kyang shin tu 'grub bla ba lags/ de la spyi rtag brtan gyi sa phyogs 'di rdo rang ta mod pa'i rigs su 'dug kyang*/ rnam grangs mang po nas tshol ba dang*/ gcog pa sogs mi dgos par rdo'i khung bu 'khris nas 'khris su thon pa dang*/ yos lo dang 'brug lo'i dbyar gung sgrub pa mo rnams kyis kyang rdo cung zad bsags pa'i dus/ rdo khung rnying pa gcig phal cher zad/ gsar ba gcig 'tshol dgos snyam pa'i skabs nub mo brag cig zhig nas rdo zad pa med pa de 'dra lan gnyis byung*/ sngar phyogs thams cad bye mas khyab pa'i rtsig 'dam dang gyangs sogs shin tu dkon dkon 'dra ba la phyogs gang dang gang du nam dgos dgos su/ 'khris de dang de nas sa spyin po gang 'dod du 'byung ba dang*/ gtsug lag khang gi zhal sa sbyor ma dgos par legs par sbyar sbyar ba 'dra ba kho na gang 'dod du thon zhing*/ gtsug lag khang re grub pa na/ de yang rdzogs 'gro ba dang*/ snga phyir las ka 'di tsam du rgya che ba la yang*/ gong du smos pa ltar dam sel dang gtor ma 'gyangs pa'i nyes skyon phran bu de tsam ma gtogs las ka la brten nas mi shi ba lta ci smos/ yan lag la rmas yar tsam yang ye ma byung ba 'di yang ngo mtshar che shos cig yin/

gong du smos pa ltar chu mig gsar pa lu ma'i rigs can brdol pas/ dgun grang dus su mi 'khyag cing*/ shing btab pa thams cad la ci 'dod du drangs pas chog pa/ zhing sogs gang la'ang gnod pa med pa dang*/ phyogs 'di kun mkhar las byed pa la shing shin tu dkon pas/ dka' spyad kho na dgos pa yin yang*/ stod smad rnams nas 'bad rtsol med par sab seb skyabs skyibs du ma nas/ shing ci 'dod du nyos pas chog pa byung zhing*/ skabs skabs su sde srid nas kyang mang du gnang mod/ phal cher rin bcal te nyos pa shas che ba la thams cad nyo bla zhing 'tshol bla ba sha stag byung*/ shing stong shin tu sbam pa sgul skyod thongs dka' ba kun yang*/ sa thag ring po nas 'dren pa la dka' ba med cing nyes skyon ye ma byung ba yin/ de bzhin du gser zangs kun yang*/ snga sor jo nang gi byams pa bzhengs pa yan chad du thams cad zad par byas pa yin yang*/ de phyin sde pa nas gser zho brgya phrag brgya phrag tu bcad pa lan drug tsam dang*/ gzhan yang snga phyir gsil ma mang du gnang mod/ spyi babs deng sang dus ngan de mi rnams 'byor pa chung bas/ gser dkon zhing ster ba nyung yang*/ lho stod smad 'di rnams su/ chos gzhis kyi yong sgo rnams las bsgrubs pa yin yang*/ gser zangs gnyis ci 'dod du sgrub shin tu bla bar byung*/ spyi babs da lta las lo brgya tsam gyi sngon rol lta bu'am/ rong byams chen dang*/ ngam ring gi byams pa bzhengs pa sogs kyi skabs la cha bzhag na/ de dus kyi zho stong dang*/ da lta'i zho brgya yang zho brgya sgrub rtsol dka' nges shes pa yin 'dugakho bos dran pa nas da lta'i bar du yang ches dkon par song snang*/ de bzhin du dngul chu shin tu dkon pa yin yang*/ yos 'brug sbrul gyi lo gsum la dngul chu shin tu mang ba sgo skyel gyi tshul du byung bas/ gser zangs kyi las ka 'di tsam byed pa la yang*/ slar dka' bas 'tshol dgos pa sogs ye ma byung ngo*/

/ sngar yan chad sku gzugs bzhengs pa la dngul chu zho grangs su btab na khri tsho lngar nye ba song*/ lha khang gi sgo'i shan sogs rtag brtan gyi skor 'di la lcags rang yang lcags sgyed phyed dang nyis brgya tsam/ sla nga nyis brgya lhag tsam/ thong lcags bdun brgya skong de snga yan chad la song bas mtshon/ rgya gar shar phyogs nas tshong pa rnams kyis/ snga phyir li khri mi rgyab mi rgyab tu longs pa shin tu mang ba khyer byung ba dang*/ sde pa'i khral dang sgos dpon gyi khral sogs kyi sgo nas mtshal shin tu dkon yang*/ nged la mtshal mang po sgo nyal gyi tshul du byung ba dang*/ spang ma dang mthing ni sde srid nas phal cher byung ba yin te/ mi rgyab bcu pa gcig dang*/ lnga bcu pa gcig dang*/ brgya pa gcig sogs mang du byung*/ de yang spang mthing rko mkhan rnams kyis/ spang mthing shin tu mthon che ba byung bas stabs kha shin tu legs pa dang thug go / yang 'dir sa rdo'i las ka'am/ sku gsung thugs kyi rten bzheng pa sogs ci yin yang rung ste/ las byed pa po thams cad nyin zang zang las byed pa la/ gzhan gyis tsha 'dzun mi dgos par shin tu spro bas 'jug cing*/ 'du khang dang gtsang khang gi logs bris la sogs pa'i skabs su pir dang*/ tshon kong mi ma yin gyis phan tshun bsnol ba dang*/ rang rang gi sa khul gyi tshon 'gyed pa na/ 'di ltar tshon btang ngo mi dran zhing mi shes ba la/ rgya chen por sleb pa'i rigs dang*/ gtsang khang gi 'jigs byed chen po'i sku la/ sbyar mthing tshon kong chung chung gcig gi sum cha gang tsam zhig gis khyed pa sogs ngo mtshar shin tu mang ste/ snga sor sangs rgyas bdun gyi sku bzhengs skabs/ bzo bo rnams kyang lo mang po 'thogs kyi dogs pa byed kyang*/ zla brgyad kyi khongs su mtha' dag grub pa dang*/ gtso bo'i sku'i byugs gser gser zho stong tsam bzhu zhing*/ btso sbyangs byas pa'i skabs/ 'chad ye med par ma zad gser zho nyis brgya lhag tsam 'phel lo/

/ des na bar skabs zhig dge sems chung zhing phrag dog che ba'i skya ser mang po zhig nged la kha zer bar byed kyang*/ dkar phyogs skyong ba rnams byams par yod do/ / yang shing bzo/ rdo bzo/ tshem bu pa/ yig mkhan/ rkos mkhan/ par mkhan/ khyad par ri mo ba shin tu mang po dang bcas pa 'di rnams la/ lo re bzhin so so'i yon rdzong mang po zhig bsgrubs pa yin mod kyang/ 'dir yi ger 'god ma lang la/ bzo rigs pa mang ba'i dus nyis brgya sum brgya la sogs pa dang*/ ji tsam nyung yang*/ brgyar longs pa rtag tu bsten dgos shing dge 'dun mang dus su stong du nye ba dang*/ shin tu nyung ba'i dus kyang lnga brgya mi 'chad pa la phogs 'khor yug gi sgo nas rtag tu 'tsho ba'i brel ba med pa dang*/ sgrub sde na yang rang res phogs 'khor mor sbyong dgos mang du yod cing*/ gong du smos pa ltar zla re bzhin dang*/ lo dus kyi mchod thes kyang mang du sbyar ba yin/ de bzhin du sgrub sder bsam gtan gling pa rnams la dpal rdo rje phag mo'i tshes bcu'i mchod pa zla ba ngo re bzhin btsugs/ rtag brtan du yang cho 'phrul chen po'i dus kyi smon lam dang*/ tshes bcu byung ngo cog la dge 'dun phyed langs rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i tshes bcu'i cho ga gtong bar byas shing de dag so so'i gzhi skyen legs par sbyar grub pa'i skabs su yong*/ gzhan yang bzo bo spyi dang bal po sogs kyi nar ma'i chas dang*/ dus dus kyi dgos cha mang po rnams kyang bzang bar gtogs pa steng 'grus med pa dang*/ tshon dang dngul chu 'tshong bar 'ongs pas mtshon pa'i sgo drung du zung khyer nas 'ongs pa rnams la yang rin pham kha ye med cing*/ cung zad khe dang bcas par sbyin nas mdor na sdig dang ma 'dres par byas so/ / yang snga ma gcig tsa na dgon pa'i lcags ri bskor ba la/ kha cig rdzong yin par 'dug ces btsun pa ko long can rnams kyis sna drangs nas col sgrogs sbir gyis byung dus/

nged kyis gtam lan gnyis smras so/ / dang po chos dang 'brel pa'i lan ni/ rdzong cis kyang yin/ dgon pa dam pa'i chos kyi rdzong dang*/ nged theg pa chen po'i chos kyi rgyal po'i tshul du yod pa yin/ da dung yon tan gyi rdzong mang po 'phel yong ba yin/ rdzong btab pa 'dod thog rang lags so byas/ gnyis pa 'jig rten dang 'brel ba'i lan ni/ lha yul rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang dang*/ pho brang lcang lo can yang rdzong ka yin/ chos bzang lha'i bdun sa yang brag rdzong ka yin/ 'dod khams dbang phyug ma yang rdzong gi lha mo zer rdzong la ga bzhugs pa yin/ rgya gar bi kra ma shī la dang*/ o tan ta pu ri zer ba'i chos 'khor chen po de kun yang rdzong ka yin/ nyan go gang yang ma non pa snying re rje/ bod rang gi bla ma chos pa'i khul du gtogs pa la'ang*/ sngon sa skya pa dar rgyas che dus sa skya pa rang la rdzong mang*/ phyis rgud nas phal cher shor ba yin/ phyis rang 'bras spungs dga' ldan pho brang ba yang kho rang tsho dar rgyas yod dus rdzong mang da lta dar rgyas med pa dang rdzong yang med/ des mtshon pa'i 'bri stag kar gsum sogs dar rgyas yod pa rnams na da lta'ang rdzong gda' ba/ mi drag pa kun la rdzong yang yod/ g.yog kyang yong ba yin/ ma bro glu gsum dang mu ltau ba kun la rdzong byung ba'i rnam grangs med/ rdzong 'debs rgyu yong ba dang rdzong du sdod rgyu yong ba la bsod nams zer ba de yang cung zad dgos/ blo gros zer ba de yang cung zad dgos/ bya byed ma nor ba cig kyang dgos pa yin/ de tsho med na sngar yod yod po rnams kyang rta sbangs gtong ba bzhin du rim can du bskyur dgos yong gin 'dug pa ma mthong ba e yin/ khyed rang rnams kyang so so nas/ dmag dang dus zing byed 'dod dang*/ phrag dog 'gran sems ni tshugs rgyu med pa tsam 'dugapho rgod po yod na rang rang so so'i yul sde dang*/ dgon sde'i sar rdzong rgyob shoganged kyi rdzong la mig tsha rgyu ci yod pa/

nged ni dar rgyas yod pa'i rtags yin pas rdzong rgyag gin yod pa ces kyang 'dod/ yin pa ta sdig pa'i rdzong min dge ba'i rdzong yin te/ de 'dra'i go rgyu khyed tshol med/ khyed la bcol rtogs kyang med/ khyed la re che yang mi byed do byas/ chos kyi sgo nas lan btab na mi nyan par 'duga'ajig rten gyi lan btab dus nag spob spob kha rog bsdod par 'dugaspyir khong rnams de skad zer ba la rgyu gnyis 'dug ste/ gcig ni rang rang so so na rang bzang po dpe med yin par 'dod pa la dge las gang yang ma grub/ nged rnams khong rang tsho las ches ngan rgyu'i khungs byed rgyu la kho ra tshos gang yang ma byung*/ rnam dkar dge ba rlabs po che 'di nged kyis grub pas tshig pa za ba der 'dugargyu gnyis pa ni/ nged la byang pa'i phyogs dang*/ lung nag sogs nas gnod pa mang po zhig e yong na/ byung na dga' ste snyam pa dang*/ de'i phyir du rdzong rgyag pa yin yong snyam pa kho ra tsho la bsam pa ngan pa'i re go khog na yod pa de'i me tog kha nas shar ba der 'dug go / yang na nang snga rol lo shas gcig nged kyi chos grwa la chos spel ba'i bar chad byed dgos bsam pa stod smad na mang po 'dug pa de rnams kho bos ni yun ring mi gnas par dus tshod mi ring mi 'gyang ba kho na la khang rul zhig pa bzhin du stongs 'gro ba ni dang po nas go snga mo nas shes/ de khas khong tsho'i sems 'dzin pa la ma phyin pa de yin/ lar 'jigs pa yod nas sa btsan 'dzin pa min/ yin na da kha snga bang mgyogs rgyug pa re nged kyis kyang los shes/ lam la 'gro na'ang skya ser gzhan thams cad zon can du 'gro/ kho bo zon med du 'gro/ ri khrod du yang nga zon med bag skyong*/ gzhan tsho mtha' phyi thams cad bskor nas sdod kyin 'dug pa/ rgyu mtshan nga la mnong med pas yin/ yang phyis gtsug lag khang rnam grangs ches mang ba/ sku gsung thugs kyi rten gyis phyur bur gang zhing*/

chos kyi gzhi chen po sbed par mi nus pa 'di lta bu grub tsa na/ khrel med kyi kha skyag rdzun 'dra brjod mkhan tshol zhal skyengs cig rang byung song ngo'ang*/ yang kho bos mdo sngags thams cad du gzhan stong dbu ma chen po'i lugs 'di bskyangs pas/ rta lo tsam nas gzung*/ dpal ldan ka lā pa'i zhing gi bkod pa dang*/ sa bcu'i dbang phyug gi sprul pa'i sku rnams kyi sku dang gsung gi snang ba yang nas yang du byung ba dang*/ yang lan cig pa da ra'i gling na/ in+d+ra bhu tī'i sprul pa'i sku bzhugs pa'i sku dang gsung gi snang ba byung ba dang*/ yang lan cig stong gzugs kyi snang ba la brten nas/ drag po'i gling gsal bar mthong nas/ byang chub sems dpa' drag po dbang phyug gi tshul 'dzin pa lnga brgya chos ston pa'i tshul mthong ba dang*/ sher snying gi 'grel chen tshar ba'i nyin mo/ sprin gseb nas stong gzugs kyi rang bzhin rgyal ba mi pham pa la lha rnams mchod pa byed tshul sogs ya mtshan pa'i ltas mang du byung*/ lug lo'i ston ka cig rtag brtan gyi 'bras spungs na yod dus/ skyes bu dkar po gzi brjid can la phur zhabs can zhig 'khor mang dag dang bcas de nub phyogs nas byung*/ gang nas yin dris pas/ nub phyogs ba da ra'i gling nas yin/ dpag tshad khri phrag brgyad kyi pha rol nas yong ste nyi ma phyed la sleb/ 'di na sangs rgyas kyi lha khang bzhengs/ bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po'i chos la mos pa thob pa zhig yod do/ / zhes pa'i gtam/ sde brgyad gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa las thos nas lta bar 'ongs pa yin zer/ lha khang la mchod pa byed pa'i rnam pa tsam 'dugad gar 'gro dris pas/ ri bo rtse lngar 'gro/ kyai rdor gyi rtsa sngags tshar gcig 'don pa'i tshad la sleb zer/ de nas gang du 'gro/ shar phyogs kyi rgya mtsho'i dkyil gcig na rin po che'i ri bo dpag tshad nyi shu pa cig yod/ de'i rtse na 'dab chags dang*/

phug pa na phyugs kyi gzugs can/ byang chub sems dpa' mang pos sems can gyi don byed pa yod/ de la lta ba yin/ lar de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po'i gtam ston pa la lhag par mos pa thob pa zhig yin/ lha mo chu srin gdong can gyi ming po yin yang zer ba snyam byung*/ bdag dang mtshungs pa brgyad khri bzhi stong nub phyogs kyi rgya mtsho la gnas nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po'i mdo la mchod cing*/ chos 'di smra ba la grogs byed pa yin no zer ste/ de nas mi snang bar gyur/ 'di la'ang mchod gtor byin na/ rang re'i chos rgyud la gtong grogs byed pa zhig yin par 'dug go / yang nged kyi sangs rgyas byang sems la mchod pa dang*/ lha 'dre 'khyams po mtha' yas pa la/ dngos su 'tsho ba'i sgo nas phan cing*/ 'dre'i kha phyogs pas mi phyugs kun gyi srog dang longs spyod la phan par 'dugasgos su dge ba'i las rgya chen po rnams kyi bar chad zhi ba dang*/

byin rlabs kyi sgo khyad par can bsgrub pa'i phyir shing yos nas brtsam ste/ zla ba phyed re bzhin rtsam pa mi rgyab gsum re la gtor rtsam byas/ dkar rgyan sogs dgos cha de dang mthun pa/ chang tshong re re gnyis gnyis tsam re'i gtor chang dang bcas pa'i gtor ma 'chag med du phul/ skabs gang dgos su mchod gtor ka to ra gnyis gsum khengs pa tsam phul ba la rtsis btab med/ rgyab ri'i rtse mor gtor ma gtong thengs 'di yin la lan bzhi song ba la/ re re bzhin du rtsam khal brgya nas nyis brgya bar re yong bar byas/ de ltar byed pa la zla bo kun dga' dpal bzang ma gtogs/ thog ma rang re'i lag g.yog thams cad kyis kyang blor ma chud/ zan 'di tsam rang grog po la bskur ba zer/ smyo zhugs pa yin nam snyam pa byed kyin 'dugadeng sang phal cher zhig lha la mchod pa phul yang mi 'bul/ phul nas kyang tshur sdud par gda'/ mchod ro tshur mi sdud par dengs su 'jug pa de nga'i khyad chos yin/ de yang da lta dge ba la dkar ba kun/ dge 'dun gyi zhabs tog gam/ skye bo'i sbyin gtong lta bu la cung zad blos thongs par gda' ste za mkhan dngos su 'dug pa la yid ches pas phan yon la bsam pa yang 'dugayang de dang de la grags pa yang 'byung snyam pa dang*/ za mkhan de rnams kyis grags pa sgrog go snyam pa dang*/ mi la phyin pa la yus dang ngo so yong ba dang*/ kha lan gcig kyang yong ba dang*/ kha cig rang phyogs 'dzin par 'gyur snyam pa'am sngar ma dang pha'am dgra byed mkhan yin na rab tu tshur e khugs/ de min dgra mi byed la re ba sogs su 'dugasangs rgyas sogs lha la mchod par 'bul mi nus pa de/ longs spyod mkhan e yod mi shes snyam pa'i/ mdor na sangs rgyas dang lha yod pa tsam du yid ches kyang med pa dang*/ de med pas grags pa dang*/ ngo so dang*/ rang re'i phyogs 'dzin pa sogs mi yod snyam pa der gda'/ 'di log lta'i zhad chen po yin par 'dugalog lta'i gnyen por rjes su dran pa drug sgom dgos pa yin/

sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dag/ kun tu thogs med gzigs par ldan/ / zhes pa'i don 'di la bdag ni nges shes snying thag pa nas skyes bdogazhing gi dam pa bla ma yi dam chos skyong rnams la mchod pa phul ba'i phan yon 'di la yid ches chen po cig kyang byung*/ lha mthu bo che rnams rang re la rtag tu blta bzhin yang yod/ mi la re ba ma che lha la gsol ba thob ces pa 'di bden gtam chen po cig tu yang go lags/ yang rang res dgon pa'i rgyan du 'gyur ram snyam/ 'brug lo dgon pa'i nub kyi phyogs rgyal byed tshal du ming bzhag pa 'di dang*/ rta lug la byang phyogs dang*/ spre'u lo la shar phyogs kyi bar du ljon shing btsugs pa rnams bdag med lta bur bskyur bzhag kyang legs par skyes shing*/ sngar ne'u sing cung zad tsam las med pa/ 'brug lo kho na la ne'u sing shin tu rgya che bar mched pa sogs kyang*/ lha klu rnams dga' ba'i rten 'brel du 'dug cing*/ yang gangs can 'di na bla chen mang bo zhig da lta yang yod de/ sngon nas bsags pa'i bang mdzod mtha' yas pa yang mnga'/ nged lta bu'i lag tu tshe gang la 'byung ba'i rgyu nor yang*/ skabs re nyi ma re re dang*/ zla ba re rer 'byung ba dang*/ dbus gtsang khams gsum gyis cha na mnga' zhabs rdzong gzhis ji snyed cig yod cing*/ phyogs 'dzin zhen mthen gyi ban skya pho mo mtha' yas pa yod pa rnams kyang*/ mthar gtugs na bsod nams rnam pa gsum dang*/ thos bsam sgom gsum dang*/ rang gzhan smin grol gyi mdzad pa ni/ ston dus kyi 'brug sgra bzhin du sgra 'ur kho nar 'dug na/ bdag cag lta bu bang mdzod la mngon par dga' ba yang ma yin no/ / yang rang gi dge ba cung zad re byed zer nas de la bsnyad pa'i g.yog rigs la khral dang*/ zhal dkar len pa dang*/ grwa rigs yon bdag sogs rgyal khams kyi skye bo 'brel can 'brel med che phra skya ser sna tshogs pa'i sar 'bul sdud dang slong mo'am/

dge bskul sogs kyi ming btags pa'i gzhogs slong kha gsag rnyed pas rnyed pa tshol ba/ thob kyis 'jal ba la sogs pa thabs sna tshogs kyis gzhan nor bsdu ba'i mkhos byed pa kho na mang bar snang yang*/ kho bos ni de lta bu sna gcig kyang ma byas shing shugs 'byung la longs spyod gang byung tshad dge ba la sbyar ba ma gtogs/ gsog pa'i 'dun pa med pas/ nged lta bu gnangs chung kho na yin yang lag rjes mi chung tsam grub pa 'di yin/ 'di la yang nga rgyal ma byas des dka' las dka' dgu 'di tsam byas snyam pa'i yus pa yang med/ da 'di gzhan la gtong mi thub snyam pa'i shi 'ju ro 'changs su gab nas sdod snyam pa yang med/ gzhan la 'gran pa'i zur rnon ta ga la zhig ste/ rang ngam 'brel can rnams la dge ba'i 'brel ba phran bu gzhog thub na/ cung zad legs sam snyam pa tsam lags/ lar bya ba las kyi 'khor lo'i dge ba brgya thams pa las/ tshul khrims rnam par dag pas thos bsam gyi dge ba gcig bzang ba yin/ de 'dra brgya tham pa las/ bden bzhi stong nyid byang chub sems kyi don yid la byed pa'i dge ba gcig dga' ba yin/ don 'di la nges pa rnyed pas nged la rlom sems mi yong ba'i rgyu mtshan yang de lags/ 'on kyang deng sang tshul khrims dag pa dang sgom yid byed de nyin mo'i skar ma las kyang dkon no/ / des na bya ba las kyi 'khor lo gtso bor byas pa'i rgyu mtshan yang de na bdog/ sangs rgyas byang sems kyi dgongs pa sems can rnams gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi bde ba la 'god pa kho nar gda' yang*/ sems can la phan pa la phan 'dogs lugs cig dgos/ rab byung chos pa'i khungs kyis skye bo mi nag la sgur ba dang*/ dad rdzas kyi nor rnams rngan par ster ba dang*/ nag chang longs spyod kyi thes la sbyor ba la 'gro don zer ba min/ gzhan don zer ba yang min/ sems can la phan pa zer ba yang min/ rang dang sbyin pa byin pa'i yul gnyis kar ngan song gi g.yang sar lag sbrel byas nas/

mchong ba zer ba de yin/ chos pa shes ldan 'dra yod na yang go las che/ 'jig rten skye bo shes ldan 'dra yod na yang go las che/ da ni bskal pa rnying pas shes ldan tsam yod yong de mi 'dra/ phyogs thams cad rne mchog chen po'i gling du swāhā/ tshul de bzhin go nas nged kyis ni lag len du btab kyang btab/ khel yang khel/ dad pa can bslur mi rung zhes grags te/ dad pa can yin nges shes pa de yid bzhin nor bu las kyang dkon par gda'/ rang dang 'brel pa can ma bslus pa gcig dgos so// da ni rang gi blo 'dod 'tsho ba'i lhag ma ji tsam yod pa 'di/ yang dag pa'i don la mnyam par 'jog pas dus 'da' bar byas na ci ma rung snyam pa 'di kho na yid la bcags pa ni lags/ 'jig rten chos brgyad kyi 'dam du bying bas 'grub par ni dka' ba 'dug na'ang*/ tshe rabs rgyud ma nas rgyud ma/ bskal pa nas bskal pa 'byams klas par theg pa mchog gi chos la mos pa dang*/ 'jug pa phun sum 'tshogs pa mi 'bral bar spyod pa'i go cha la gnas pa tsam 'di brtad so yin/ da ni dkyus kyi 'phros de las cung zad tsam brjod par bya ste/ de rjes kyang rtsom pa thang thung 'dra dang*/ ston ka de skyid phug bde ldan du mtshams cung zad cig kyang byas/ de skabs 'tshub cha rnam 'gyur cung zad che ba 'ga' zhig byung zhing*/ mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i don yang yang bsams shing*/ rdo rje'i rnal 'byor sgom pa'i lugs byas/ tho rangs cig stong gzugs kyi snang ba ka yin pa 'dra/ rigs drug gi sngags 'khor rnams sgeg pa'i rdo rje'i lugs dang mthun pa gcig shin tu gsal ba yun ring du gnas shing 'od 'phro ba cig byung*/ snga sor sde srid sku gzhogs su pho nya btang zhing*/ rab tu hor zla bdun pa dang*/ de min yang brgyad pa dgu pa'i khongs su yar phebs thub nges shes pa cig dgos pa dang*/ de min sku dog che ba 'dug tshul sogs zhur btang ba la/

de ltar gnang ba'i dgongs brtad dang*/ de mthun gyi gsung lan 'byor byung na'ang*/ skyes chen du rdzu ba 'ga' zhig gis dgongs don gyi gegs kho na byed pa nga la phyi nang bar gsum nas mang pos zhor bteg pa'i ar 'khyams nas phebs ma thub/ 'di skabs g.ye gor chos rdzong na bzhugs dus/ mi zhig yar gnang byung nas/ cung zad sku ltems kyang ma lod tsam yod/ slar rim gro sogs ji ltar gsung ba zhig byung ba la/ da lam bsnyung ba de grib dang gdon gnyis kar che/ mi ngan gcig mjal bas nyin bslangs 'dugad lam gyi 'di rang skyon med na ang*/ slar ro ma langs nyen che ba yod pa 'dra/ dmigs gsal sku rim 'dra*/ gnang dgos tshul zhus/ skabs 'di dag tu sog po'i dmag chen rting ma'ang sleb skabs yin/ de rjes zla ba bcu pa'i nang du rtag brtan na yod dus/ gzhal yas khang gi logs bris kyi mngon byung mgon po gnyis la rab gnas byas dus/ skad cig la rlung nag mi bzad pa rang langs/ shing shag thams cad 'phangs pa sogs rtsub 'gyur che zhing*/ rtog dpyad du mngon tsam zhig byung*/ de rjes hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu bzhi'i nyin/ bsam 'grub rtse nas dpon sa a lce'i drung gi sku rim mang ja zhig byung ba la/ tshes bcu tsam nas sku ltems pa da dgos thor ba yin pa 'dug cing*/ rin po che sog bzlog drung nas lha 'brum dkar po yang yin gsung ba 'dug pa sogs yang po'i rigs yin par 'dugaskyon che ba rang mi 'dug na'ang*/ rim gro gnad du gang 'gro dgos tshul tsam 'dugade nas tshes bcu bdun la ri khrod chen por dus khrid btsugs/ nyer gcig gi srod 'jings yol la pa snam grong stod pa gzhon pa 'bod mir byung ba'i/ dpon sa a lce'i drung zhud kha'i rkyen gyis thor pa nang du log pa sogs shin tu ltem pas yong dgos tshul dang*/ sde srid rgyal bu'i drung yang shangs la phebs rgyu yin gsung ba sogs 'dug lan la rtse rang du bzhugs pas khyab/

shangs la mi legs zer ba phul na'ang/ zhu lan ma sleb gong du pa snam tshor phebs grub 'dug ste de skabs shangs la ma phebs pa de kas 'tshengs gda'/ yang spyir chos pa'i rigs kyis chos kho na la phye thang byed dgos rgyur 'dug cing*/ chos spangs nas 'jig rten pa'i khye phogs chen po dang*/ gnyen tshan yon mchod sogs kyi 'jig rten gyi bya ba gal po che gang yod kyang*/ til 'bru cig kyang mi phan pas/ chos bcag nas bya ba gal chen zen dgos zer nas rgyug pa de/ chos pa'i khyu nas bud pa yin par 'dug/ snor mangs pa sangs rgyas bzang po dang*/ o rgyan pa'i gtam rgyud bzhin yin/ chag lo ts+tsha ba/ dpang lo chen po/ kun mkhyen chen po/ bu ston rin po che/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams pa sogs la/ rgya nag rgyal pos gdan 'dren byung yang ye ma phebs/ dus phyis rang bo dong bya gshongs kyi 'chad nyan pa rje sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan pa de/ chos sgang la mi chen bsnyung ba dang 'das grongs kyi rigs sam dga' ston sogs gal che gang 'dra cig la spyan 'dren pa byung yang mi 'byon pa'i thag chod po cig yod zer/ de bden na chos brgyad chung zhing chos la gnas pa'i rnam thar du 'dug snyam pa byung deng sang de 'dra'i rigs la mi chos mi shes pa/ dgos dus mi phan pa zer nas thams cad kha gtong bar 'dugachos de med khungs med du btang nas 'jig rten gyi khye phogs la/ che bzhag chung bshol gyi phan thogs rdzus ma res mgo bo bskor du phyin na/ mi nag pa tsho dga' bar ma zad/ chos pa tsho yang de kha rang dga' ba'i khungs kyis bstod ra dir byed par 'dugami chen skya ser shes ldan yin pa'i khungs tsho yang de kha rang dge bshes bzang bar 'dzin par 'duga'ajig rten pa rnams de skad smra ba ni shin tu blun mod de/ skye bo mi nag pa chos ma go tsa na thabs med/ dgag pa'i yul du ma byung*/ chos pa rnams kyi kha nas de bzhin smra/

yid nas de ltar sems pa ni kho rang bdud kyi dbang du song ba der 'dugathabs med kyang chos sam bstan pa rang de rtsa ba nas nub pa yin par 'dugasnyam yid skyo ba'i rgyu kho nar gda'/ khyad par jo nang gi dus khrid 'di shin tu bka' gnyan par byed/ sngon rje btsun grol mchog thugs gtum pas/ chos gsung 'phro bzhag nas phebs pa mang*/ ngor du slob ma sta gon cig gnang grub kyang*/ thugs 'ur nas dngos gzhi ma gnang bar thegs pa'i lo rgyus yod/ gzhan yang lam 'bras gsung 'phro la bor nas thegs pa sogs mang bo byung yang*/ jo nang dus 'khrid snga res gnang ba cig la/ blo bde nas dpon drung rab brtan pa shin tu bsnyung nas spyan 'dren dos drag byung kyang ma thegs/ de la skyon mi yong gsung ba'i zhal bzhes kyang mdzad/ de skabs skyon yang ma byung 'dugayang phyi res cig rgyal rtse nas bdag po nam mkha' lhun grub shin tu bsnyung ba la spyan 'dren dos drag byung ba la'ang*/ sbyor drug 'di chos gzhan dang mi 'dra bas bag med byas na 'phral du nyen cha che zhing*/ phugs rnam smin brji gsungs nas 'khrid ma grol bar du phebs ma thub/ rgyal rtse bdag po'ang de rjes sku 'das nas ma mjal bar gda'/ dgongs rdzogs la ni phebs 'dugades mtshon yang sgos su yang 'di skabs ltas shin tu ngan pa'i phan thogs cig mi yong ba 'dug pa dang*/ lar nas kyang sku gshegs de phyi ltar gus la snying nas ma dad pa'i rnam 'gyur cig kyang 'dug pas mi 'gro bar thag bcad/ khrid kyi 'phros de kha bskyangs/ de nas nyer gsum gyi nub mo a lce drung gshegs zer nas/ nyer drug gi snga dro mgyogs bsngo skyel mkhan sleb/ pa snam du sde srid rgyal bu'i drung du/ sku srung dang byin rlabs rten 'bul du rta rdzi don yod dpal bzang kho btang bas/ jo nang ri khrod nas zhogs phyed la thon pa la/ sa hrab hrib la pa snam rdzong du 'byor ba'i de 'phral zhu yig rten sogs 'bul thub pas ngo mtshar ba'ang byung*/

khrid kyi 'go mjug 'di kun tu/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i sgrub thabs slob dpon spyod pa pas mdzad pa'i rgya gzhung gi ṭīka chen de brtsoms grub par byung*/ khrid gsar ba mang shos med kyang 'khrid lo shin tu legs/ 'di skabs sde srid nas bka' shog phebs pa la/ cung zad sku ltem byung bas/ thor pa rang ni min las che'am skyabs 'jug dang*/ rim gro ji ltar dgos phebs byung ba/ mchod shoms kyi mar me glo bur du zad pa sogs bkra shin tu ngan pa cig byung*/ de mthun zur tsam phul/ 'khrid ma grol tsam la sde srid nas bkas khyab pa'i a lce'i drung gi byang chog sogs byung*/ 'khrid gtor gyi zor 'phen skabs/ phyi nang gi rlung ltas shin tu 'tshub pa dang*/ khrom thams cad kyis tshor ba sku 'bum thang du sgra chen po mi bzad pa cig byung*/ de nas 'bod mi yang yang gnang ba'i stabs/ byi lo hor zla dang po'i tshes lnga tsam la khrid grol/ bdun la rtag brtan du sleb tsam byas nas/

zhag bzhi'i ring la 'grib rlung kha yug shin tu che/ tshes bcu gcig la rtag brtan nas chas 'ongs dus/ khams rings pa'i gshin bsngo cig dang*/ bkra shis sgang shar pa'i nang nas 'ongs dus kyang*/ gnas sgo slob dpon rgya ma chos mdzad pa dang phrad pa'i gshin bsngo rnam grangs mang ba rang cig dgos par byung ba la/ rten 'brel mi legs pa'i dpyad du go ba cig shar/ de skabs zla ba snga ma'i mar ngo'i bcu bzhi pa/ sa skya nas bdag chen bsod nams dbang po sku gshegs pa zhag shas shin tu gsang*/ de skabs tshes bcu la gsang brdol ba'i rigs yin par 'dugade dus nged kyis lung nag gi ltag tsam der skad cha go nged rang shab chu thon/ khal ma rnams rjes la yong gin yod pas/ bdag chen sku gzhon pa a mis drung dgyes shing spro bas/ dung rgya gling dar 'phyar sogs bzab shoms du ma dang bcas nas dge sdings su phebs pa mthong 'dugatshes bco lnga la spa mnam rdzong du 'byor/ de'i nang par nas ka sde srid rgyal bu'i drung du/ dbang bka' rnams 'bul ba'i 'go brtsams/ yid yul ma bde ba cig la zhag gsum bzhi tsam song skabs/ dbus nas sde srid snga sor thor pas bsnyung ba da dgos dga' rab yong ba 'dra gsum ba cig phebs byung*/ de rjes gzhung lam de kun la dmag mi dam dum 'gro mkhan dang*/ rings rings 'dra ba'i mi 'dra mthong ba la yang*/ yid yul du the tshom 'char ba'i mdangs yod pa cig ka byung*/ de nas rong pa bkras dar zer ba kho nged dbus la 'bod mir gnang ba/ pa snam du nyer gsum la 'byor pa las ni ma byung*/ bla gnyan 'khris pa lta bu'i sku khams legs/ sa mi 'phrod pa'i thugs dogs shar bas/ sde srid rang yar phebs pa'i dgongs gtad dang*/ gang mjal mjal du 'phrad yong dgos tshul phebs par 'dugade'i sang nyin gtor ma rgyas pa cig btang ba la ni/ phyi ltas 'ja' tshon sogs legs legs 'dra ba cig byung*/ de'i yang sang nyin lam du zhugs yongs pas/

sman chu lung gi pha tshad de khar nam mkha' 'brug dang phrad byung*/ yi ge phyi ltar rnams gtad/ chu gnyan thub phyin/ der sde srid de nyid sku gshegs tshul mgyogs bsngo dang bcas pa/ blon chen rnams kyi gros steng nas yin zer ba cig sprad byung zhing*/ dus mi bde ba'i stabs re zhig shin tu gsang rgyu yin pa dang*/ sde srid rgyal bu'i drung du'ang re zhig snyan du mi 'bul zhing*/ slar khong rang tsho byon nas snyan 'bul byed dgos yin zer ba sogs 'dugasku gshegs yul ni bzang yul mon pa gdong du sgar thog tu gshegs gda'/ de rjes dol mda' rdzong du bzhugs yod tshul gyi gsang thabs byas/ de kha thal nas/ phyis kyang bka' blon rgyus yod tsho yang dol la phebs pa la ni thugs rtog cig kyang yong 'dug zer ba cig 'duganga'i sems la ni dol du gshegs pa min pa la/ lar skye bo mi nag pa'i gtam phal pa la 'brel ta ci yong ste/ khong tsho gtan tshigs che che mo rang byed 'dug pa de yin/ 'jungs la aṃ bsam pa cig byung*/ de nas slar pa snam rdzong du ka phyin/ hor zla gnyis pa'i mgo sgang de khar bsdad/ nyin re bzhin dbang chos rnam grangs gnyis gsum re mi chag pa phul zhing*/ bstan 'dzin rin po che sprul pa'i sku dpon slob kyang chos zhu bar phebs/ nai gu chos drug sogs shangs chos cha tshang dang*/ gsang ba 'dus pa ye shes zhabs lugs sogs dbang bka' 'ga' re yang byas/ dpon sa nam mkha' mdzod ma dang*/ bkras sgang ba'i dge slong ma'i ming can stabs cig tu 'das pa'i bsngo rten yang 'byor/ khong dpon g.yog bcu lhag cig sdebs su 'das 'dug ste/ dug lings byung ba yin par 'dugade nas zla ba gsum pa'i 'go la/ 'dol byung du 'bod mi nan chen byung ba ltar phyin/ thal rlung chen pos lam ye mi mthong ba byung*/ zhag bdun bsdad/ zhal ngo rnams la 'dod chos sngar rgyun ltar sgrubs/ tshogs pa mkhan chen kun dga' lung rig pa yang phrad par phebs shing*/

bde mchog dril bu pa kha che paṇa chen lugs kyi dbang bskur zhig kyang thugs bzhed ltar byas/ de nas bsam sdings su phyin/ sa mtho bas zhag gnyis rlung khams kyi shin tu na bar byung*/ da lta'i sde srid zhabs drung gi dgongs gtad kyis mgon po'i bris sku cig rtag brtan du bris pa snga dro gcig 'byor byung ba/ bya rog mang po dus gcig tu sleb pa'i ngo mtshar ba'i ltas tsam byung*/ gser mdog can mkhan chen shākya bstan 'dzin drung yang phebs/ thugs bzhed ltar lam dbang cig byas/ mgon po brag nag gshan pa drug pa'i rjes gnang la chos mtshams byung*/ nyin cig jo mo'i ri rtser phyir nas yon bdag gi sku rim du gtor ma rgya che ba zhig btang dus/ byang shar nas rlung shugs can rang 'dugaphyi ltas 'tshub par mngon pa tsam byung*/ slar yang pa snam rdzong du sleb/ rdzong rang gi nye skor na 'brum bags mang po rang 'dug cing*/ la la phyir gseng ba'i khungs byed 'dug ste/ spre'u yos rku'i rnam pa las mi 'dug kyang*/ de res skor sku 'brum ye ma byung ba de yin/ de skabs rtag brtan gyi dpal chen lha khang du/ logs bris la a bhe dha na nas 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo phal che ba dang*/ zhing skyong nyer bzhi mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho nas 'byung ba ltar dang*/ gtsang khang nang du bde mchog rtsa rgyud kyi lha tshogs 'bri ba'i bkod pa dang*/ sngar mtshon rtsi ma gsol ba rnams la mtshon rtsi gsol ba'i bkod pa yang byas/ nged la 'bod mkhan yang med/ sde srid la spyan 'dren yang med de/ zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes brgyad la yon mchod lhan du bsam grub rtser 'byor/ lam zhor la dud mtsho'i 'khris kyi skyed tshal der phyin dus/ g.yabs ring la mi la'i rnam thar bkod pa'i khungs zhig bris 'dug pa/ rten 'brel log pa rang zhig byung 'dugasnga sor sde srid du gsang brtol 'bul rgyu de/ pa snam du bar chad kyi rgyur 'gyur bas mi legs pa dang*/

bsam rtser legs pa dang*/ dus tshod de kha tsam nas sde srid zhabs drung rang bzhugs yul yang*/ pa snam cung mi legs pa'i mtshan ma shar ba nas rtse la phebs pa yin/ de khas gang ci nas pho brang ma mor phebs thub pas/ rdzong gzhis rang la'ang blo brling ba dang*/ mtha' bzhi kun tu zil che ba'i legs lam dang*/ rtse phyogs sa yang gtsang zhing*/ yar phyogs de rjes thor pa sogs nang bags kyang cher song ba zhig byung bas/ ltas kyang don dang mthun pa de yin/ de skabs gzhan blon chen bka' gros pa'am/ rdzong dpon sogs gang gis kyang rtse la phebs na legs pa'i snyan bskul spyan 'dren sogs su yang med/ khong rang tshol rang 'dod kyi gnad phran tshegs rtsi rgyu yang 'dug pas/ rtser ma byon pa la dngos dga' ba'i rigs yin par yang 'dugaphebs pa'i gnangs nyin ka thog mar mdzod pa gnas tshul zhu bar btang*/ de 'phral dngos kyis kyang zhib rgyas phul/ thugs khog che bar byung bas sngar gyi sems khur gyis 'tsher pa sangs sku'i bar chad sel byed kyi dbang bka' 'chag med re phul zhing*/ bstan 'dzin rin po che dang gzhan yang ci rigs la/ dbang lung rjes gnang rnam grangs mang ba tsam byas/ de nas gsang brtol snyan du phul grub tshul/ dbus phyogs su blon chen rnams la'ang bsrings/ sngar mgon khang cig yod pa bar skabs su bdag rkyen chung ba'i skyon la thugs rtog kyang cung zad 'dugamagon khang rgya bkyed pa'i dgongs brtad shar bas/ 'gol skyid zer ba'i gzim khang de'i phu mda' la bcos ci rigs pa'ang gnang*/ bsas khang pas mgon po 'khor mangs kyi zhal thang cig kyang bris/ gnas rnying pa'i lha bzos mgon po lcam dral gyi sman sku yang bzhengs shing*/ de dag la rab gnas kyang legs par byung*/ mgon khang rten rdzas dang bcas pa cha tshang sgrig rtsom grub/ de'i gong tsam du 'phyong rgyas kyi 'go byas pa'i rdzong gzhis 'ga' zhig yar stod pa la phar shor ba dang/

dbus kyi dpon rigs che ba 'ga' zhig kyang*/ kham 'gros de go rig byung ba la brten pa'i gang la 'chus 'gro mi shes pa'i g.yengs pa'i skabs yin/ de dus sde srid rang la'ang dkon mchog gis mi bslu ba'i yid ches thugs 'gel chen po thugs la 'dug kyang 'dugabla ma dkon mchog chos skyong dang bcas pa'i thugs rgyud bskul zhing gsol ba 'debs pa la thugs rtsol chen po mdzad kyang mdzad/ rang res kyang dmigs pa'i rgyab skyor gang yod byas/ mgon khang btsugs pa nas gzung dge ba'i rtags mtshan yang shar/ de dus sde pa'i phyag na chibs pa 'os rigs med pas mgon po lcam dral gyi zungs 'dzugs pa la/ mgon rta bde legs kun smon dang*/ lha mo la dre'u zhig btsugs rta dres gnyis po sde srid rang gi phyag tu phul/ lar de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po glo bur gyi dri mas g.yogs pa'i dpe dang 'dra bar pa snam nas rtser phebs skabs/ nam bza' tshun chod mda' thung ba dang phyag g.yog dpon rigs kyi bu 'ga' zhig kyang 'gro 'tshams byas nas mi sdod pa sogs nged kyi ni blo la mi ran pa cig rang byung*/ mgon gsol bskang gso ba bzhi sde 'dzugs pa'i dgongs pa yang thog ma rang nas sde srid rang la thun mongs ma yin pa shar ba yin/ mi gzhan 'ga' res bsam pa la/ nged kyis rang 'dod kyi snyan 'bul phul ba la/ sde srid sku na gzhon pas mno ma mkhyen par gsan pa yin snyam pa dang*/ kha nas kyang smra bar 'dug ste/ mgon khang 'dzugs pa dang*/ mgon gsol ba 'dzugs pa/ thugs dam gtor bsngo bskang gso la brtson pa 'di kun/ sde pa rang gi dgongs gtad thun mong ma yin pa shar ba kho na yin/ nged kyis ta phyag g.yog rnams ma mgu yi dogs nas/ da bzod tsam rim pas gnang na khyab bam zhus te/ snga khyad che ba'i dgongs pas 'phral du gnang ba yin/ lar dkon mchog la blo gtod cing dge ba la rtsol ba de mdzad pa dga' lod ji ltar yin/

byed lugs nor ram ma nor shes ldan yongs la dris shigade skabs thugs rtsol mdzad pa dkas legs/ de min nag phyogs snying la zhugs pa'i 'gal rkyen byed mkhan mang bas phyis phyag thog tu khel ba dka' ba 'dugader ma zad chos skyong 'dis de dus srog rtsa nas bzung*/ de min byus mtha' nas bsdus 'gro bar 'dugade dus dbus nas gros byed pa tshos zhu yig phul ba tsho'i gzhug na'ang*/ dkar phyogs kyi lha la mchod 'phrin dgos zer ba re 'dug pa de'i dkar phyogs ngos 'dzin/ pe kar kho na yin pa 'duga'adi phyogs dang mar phyogs na yod pa thams cad ye shes kyi mgon po la shin tu mi dga'/ 'tshub chen po yod zer/ pe dkar la blo snying brang gsum gtong*/ bde skyid thams cad yong ba yin zer/ nyams ci yang med pa'i blun po shes ldan du re ba a re sdug a re sdugasnying re rje snying re rje/ ji skad du/ kye ma bsod nams zad pa'i mi/ / lha skal chad nas 'byung po sgrub/ / ces dang*/ bka' dam glegs bam las/ mthu chen 'dod pas pe kar sgrub/ grub ma thag tu srog kyang bcad/ / shi nas ngan song 'grim pa mthong*/ / zhes gsungs pa de go yang*/ mgo thog tu ni babs 'dug go / 'di rgyal po pe ha ra kho na'i skyon gyi lugs min/ 'jig rten phal pa drag shul can kun gyi lugs yin/ sngar mi bsten pa cig gis 'dre chen po re gsar du bsten dgos na/ kho rang gi dam tshig bsre lugs dang*/ kho dbang du bsdu lugs dang*/ rten 'brel bsgyur phyogs mang po dang*/ sngar gyi lha dang 'khon sel dang*/ phyi 'brang gi bgegs sel tshul thabs mang po cig bla ma nus pa cung zad yod pa cig gis byed dgos/ de min 'dre drag shas kho rang dang mu ma 'byor ba'i sngon la/ 'khor gdug pa can rnams kyis gong kha'i sgo nyal gtong ba yin/ lha rnying pa yang dang 'gras 'gro ba yin/ dang po'i grub thob yin zer ba de 'dras kyang*/

gtsang btsan sogs 'jig rten rang rgyud pa min/ ye shes pa'i sprul pa yin zer te/ gnas tshul la 'jig rten 'das pa'ang yin srid/ sangs rgyas min pa sus shes/ 'phral 'jig rten pa'i tshul bstan pa rang gis/ ye shes pa'i khyu nas bud/ lam sna 'dren mkhan yin na 'jig rten pa'i tshul sten don rang med/ sangs rgyas byang sems cig bshan pa'i tshul bstan yod na/ khong bshan pa dngos kyi bya ba byed kyi/ legs par rab tu nyon la yid la bzung shig dang zer chos bshad mi yong*/ 'o 'jig rten pa'i tshul bzung ba de ka kho 'jig rten pa'i tshul 'dzin dgos tsa na/ gsod gcong brdung 'phrog rdzun gtong*/ ma rungs pa'i las byed kyi/ zhing khams bde ba can du 'khrid rogs mi byed/ de ru dngos su 'khrid rogs byed pa la/ tshul yang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i tshul cig ka ston dgos pa lags mod/ des na rang rgyud pa yin yang 'dra/ sprul pa yin yang 'dra/ tshul de 'jig rten pa rang du 'dug na/ 'jig rten pa rang gi 'grogs lugs dang*/ bsten lugs byed dgos/ de yang 'jam po la 'jam po'i 'grogs lugs dang*/ ma rungs pa la ma rungs pa'i bsten lugs byed dgos pa yin/ des na 'jig rten 'das pa rang dang*/ 'jig rten pa yin kyang dbang phyug khyab 'jug sogs lha'i rgyal po chen po dang*/ mi yul na yod pa'i sde brgyad drag rtsal can te/ sde gsum po 'di la khyad chen po rang yod lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal mthong ma mthong sogs la'ang shin tu khyad che ba go dgos/ skabs 'dir 'di pa tsho'i bsam pa la pe dkar 'di nged la mi dkar ba'am/ jo nang pa la mi dad pa cig yin nam/ gzhan sa dge bka' gsum la dad pa cig yin pa 'dra/ de la kho bos sdang shugs byas pa 'dra snyam pa'i dogs pa mi dgos sar blun dpyad kyi dogs pa cig shar bar 'dugadapal 'dzam thang sogs jo nang pa'i dgon chos gzhis la rgyal po'i dkor bdag yod pa ming nas med/

nang gtor rang la mi 'jug ste/ nged kyi pha mes gong ma nas rgyal po la las 'chol/ ngas kyang da lta 'chol du rung*/ sa dge bka' gsum yang phyis 'byung 'di tsho rgyal 'gong la blo brtad byed kyin 'dug pa ma gtogs/ sngon dus nang gtor la mi 'jugablo brtad 'cha' sa rang mi byed lags/ chos nyams kyang med/ snga phyi'i cha rgyus ci yang med pa tsho cig gzhan las smra mkhas pa gda' ba ang*/ rgyal gnye byung zer rnam rtog langs rim gro sad sud 'dra byed kyin 'dug pa de ci yin pa 'dug pa 'a yi 'a yi/ pe ha ra chen po drag shul can ta los yin/ de yin pas ka mi dang 'dra ba yin/ lar rgyal pos chos pa drag drag bzang bzang thams cad la bar chad btang ba'i lo rgyus ni thams cad la kha zad zad shod rgyu cig ni 'dugachos la bar chad rang yong mkhan de dkar phyogs rang 'ba' zhig e yin ltos mno bsam thong*/ nged la ni khyad med do/ / pe ha ra mtho na nga yang dga' ba yin no/ / sde pa rang la ni phan mi 'dogs par gda' lags/ nga la sde brgyad su la'ang nye ring dgos pa med do [ ang ] / snga sor nas kyang rdzun po che 'ga' re'i snyan sgron gsan pa'i sde srid gshegs pa des kyang brten khang yang yang spo ba mdzad pa yang*/

cung zad mi shes pa'i rgyur song 'dug cing*/ brten khang du pe dkar gyi gtor bzhi rten rdzas sogs bca' ba mdzad 'duganyin cig de la'ang gtor ma dang*/ rten rdzas gsar pa mang po dang bcas te/ rgyal khang rang la spos/ de nub rmi lam du/ a tsar gnyis chas kha mthil la phab nas/ da dung rtse la lan cig yong dgos yong zer ba cig byung*/ de skabs char ba shin tu dkon/ bkra shis lhun po'i lha char yang ma byung*/ nged kyis rdzong gi thog rtser gtor tshogs che tsam btang bas/ de nub char che ba rang babs de nas mgon gsol bzhi sde ba rnams nang bar sleb rgyu'i tho rangs ka gsal snang gi nyams la/ ri mthon po nags tshal rgyas pa cig gi ldan na/ spe'u stod smad gnyis 'dug pa'i 'og ma de na nga rang 'dugasteng ma de nas bud med bongs che zhing gzi brjid che ba rgyan gyis brgyan pa zhig thog rtse nas nyengs kyis thon nas/ bkra shis so/ / don grub bo/ / sta sti swā sti zer ba cig byung*/ rten 'brel shin tu legs par go nang par khong rnams sleb/ hor zla drug pa nyis rtsegs kyi rting ma'i mgon po'i dus chen gyi tshes bzang ba yar ngo ba'i bcu bzhi la/ dpal legs ldan nag po chen po ye shes kyi mgon po drak+shad chen po'i bskangs gso rgyun mi 'chad pa'i dbu tshugs/ thun gtor dang gtor 'bul thams cad mgon khang gi steng gi yang rtse der phul/ de nas brtsams te zla 'phro de la/ 'phyong rgyas sogs rdzong par shor ba thams cad tshur slaugs pa dang*/ gzhan yang stod smad du byus legs kyi rnam pa yang yang byung ba'i dar 'phyar rgyun mi 'chad pa kho na'i bkra shis pa'i legs lam de kha rang byung*/ sngar gyi rmi ltas dang mthun nyin cig phyag mdzod rnams la'ang bgegs skrod rab gnas byas/ nor phyir 'brangs pa'i rgyal 'gong rnams bskrad pa'i ltas kyang gsal bar byung*/ de yan chad la bar skabs der/ da lta'i zhabs drung 'di khar sgo du ma nas rten 'brel legs tshogs khyad par can du ma 'grig pa'i dge mtshan kho na yod pa'i skabs yin/

'dir gsang brtol phul grub tshul ma btang bar la/ shar nas tsho 'dzin pa su yang sleb ma byung*/ skabs der gsang sgo'i tshul gyi sde srid de nyid phebs kyin yod par rdzu bag byas/ mgron gnyer dpon bod gong ba dang*/ bla ma sogs bzlog pa sogs rim pas 'byor ba'i brag dmar chos sde pa'i gla 'tshal der sleb pa'i dgongs mo nam 'jigs shin tu rgod pa rang cig byung*/ sang tho rangs rdzong du phebs pa'i rdzu bag tsam byas/ de dus mgron gnyer dpon gros pa kha gtso shos rang yin/ mgon khang btsugs pa la khong shin tu ma mgu bar 'dugatshogs bdag yang steng du bzhugs yul mdzad par rdzu dgos pa'i stabs yin zer nas gtor 'bul byed sa yang mar phabs nas kun gzigs steng gi thog khar byas/ dus mtshams de ka nas dar phyar gyi rigs kyang rgyun chad pa 'dra ba cig byung*/ dge 'dun ser tshogs sogs sku rim byus rim gyi rigs mang po btsugs shing*/ bdun pa'i tshes brgyad kyi nyin mo gtor zor 'phen mkhan mang du byung*/ snga sor spre'u lo rtag brtan du thog babs pa cig byung ba sogs kyang sde srid de nyid kyi kham 'gros la lta bar 'duga'adi skabs tshes brgyad la dings su shwa skyon chen po byung ba'ang dmag byus la blta bar 'dugagatsang gi rgyal srid kyi bla de dgon 'dir*/ chags 'dug ste/ smras na bden snyam pa su la'ang mi yong ba 'duganyams snang yang mi 'dug ste bla rdo nyar ma byung bar mi lag tu shor ba'i nyams cig yong nyen gda'o/ / de skabs ni gtor ltas kyi rdzi rnams mi legs pa kho na dang*/ tshes bcu'i nyin mo rdzong gi rtser rgyal gsol rgyas pa yang btang*/ bcu gcig gi nyi shar la jo gdan pa tshos rnam sras bskang gso'i gtor 'bul te/ shar steng gi rtse rang nas byed kyin 'dugalha stobs che chung dang*/ chos skyong mchog dman gyi dbye ba ma shes pas/ gtso bo ye shes kyi mgon po'i gtor stegs mar phab/

'khor gnod sbyin gyi gtor stegs rtse la bton pas rten 'brel 'chugs/ tshes bcu gcig gi snga dro'i dus de kha rang la/ dbus su pho brang dmar lcags kyi 'khris der/ dpung chen gyi thog la sog po rgyugs pa'i nyin byus nyes par ma zad/ de rjes kyang sgar skong dang bcas pa de byung ba yin/ de dag la sogs pa sngar rten 'brel legs lam gyi sgo dpag tu med pa yod pa la/ khong rang sleb pa nas gzung nas/ lo de nang du rang rten 'brel mang po logasnga sor zhabs drung gong ma de'i dgongs brtad du 'dug pa nged kyis bris yig kyang byas/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi rnam thar zhing bkod rgyas pa/ thang ka drug cu skor yod pa yang skabs der grub song*/ gong gsham zhal khebs sogs cha 'grig dang bcas legs par tshar ba la/ rab gnas rgyas par yang byas/ sde srid de nyid kyi mtshan byang gcog pa snga sor nas bsam sdings su byas pa'i byang yon rnams kyang de dus sprad byung ba la/ sngon bad rngam pa lha khang gi rten gtso nor skyong 'dul mdzad thub pa chen po'i sku 'dra de yang byung*/ de dang thub pa chen po'i zab sku 'di/ zhabs drung de nyid sku bzhugs dus rtag brtan du gnang ba'i dgongs brtad dang bka' bkod gnang ba yin 'dugadab rngam pa'i jo bo thub pa 'di sne gdong rtse na bzhugs pa la/ bla chen 'ga' zhig gis kyang nyams kyi mchod par bod mi yin pa'i lugs su byas nas ma 'dod par 'dugalar bod ma yin pa tsam gyis ngan par ta mi 'gro/ chos kyang rgya 'grel 'bring man chad las bod 'grel bzang shos rnams bzang bar mngon gsum gyis grub/ rgya lha 'bring man chad las bod chos rgyal gyi dus kyi rnams bzo sgros dang byin rlabs gnyis kar bzang*/ 'on kyang 'di rdo rje gdan nas byon par gnang zhing*/ dbus nas spyan 'dren dus dka' mo byung zer/ bsam 'grub rtse nas rtag brtan gyi bar la dka' tshegs gang yang ma byung*/

glang chen smyon pa btul ba'i sku brnyan yin pas/ jo bo phyogs las rnam rgyal du mtshan gsol nas/ gtsang khang chen mor bzhugs su gsol ba yin/ de skabs bon gong nas sogs/ gleng brjod byed dus/ ston pa'i rnam thar 'di 'tshub po rang byung zer/ 'jigs 'jigs byed pa skad 'dug chos nyams ni med/ rnam rtog ni rgod 'o re brgyal/ sangs rgyas kyi rnam thar bzhengs pa la 'tshub yong na/ sangs rgyas kyi sku 'dra bzhengs pa la'ang 'tshub ci'i phyir mi 'ong*/ de la'ang yong na/ 'tshub mi yong pa'i lha sku mi srid par thal/ kla klo tu ru ka'i grub mtha' de ka rang du gda'/ lha sku yin snyam nas mi gzugs rdab rdob/ rgyal 'gong gi sdod sa 'dra la blo btod la/ phar hreng tshur hreng gi 'di phyi gnyis med de khyed rang tsho la yong ba yin snyam pa byung*/ snga sor phebs mtshams nas nga'i yid la da lta dka' las byas kyang*/ phugs rtig po rang yang med/ de bas rang gi dgon par phyin pa dga' snyam pa byung yang*/ phyag g.yog rnams ma sleb par la dgongs pa zhu ma nus/ mgron gnyer dpon slaub mtshams nas yang yang dgongs pa bzhus kyang*/ dus gzengs 'khrugs ches pa dang*/ bya bral de rnams la rgyang tsam 'gor/'bring 'tshams lho rtsa khog la ltos pa'i dge 'dun tshogs shin tu che zhing*/ skye bo'i sbyin gtong gi bar du mtha' rgyas rang mdzad song*/ dngos gzhi teb ra'i sa khul yangs sa der/ dge 'dun stong phrag gnyis tsam 'dus pa'i steng du/ nged kyis dge ba'i rtsa ba sgrib gnyis byang ba dang byang chub tu bsngo ba rgyas par byas/ de nub dga' ldan rtser sleb zhag gnyis bsdad/ de nas rje bla chen ye shes drung dang*/ sde pa rang dang bcas nged yon mchod thams cad kyis zar skya rang phebs/ sngar gyi skyar chos sde ni lhag lus phran bu tsam las dengs 'dug pas/ der da lta'i chos 'khor bde chen gyi gnas gzhi gtsug lag khang dang bcas pa 'di bzheng ba'i dgongs brtad mdzad/

gtor chog rgyas pa dang bcas pas sa blang ba dang*/ mchod yon gyi cho ga sngon du 'gro bas sa chog rgyas pa cig byas/ byang phug gi jo bo la mos pa chen po yod pas/ de res kyang nyin skor cig mjal du phyin/ byang phug pa rje kun dga' legs pa de/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan gyi bu chen phyag tshar ma yin/ khong gis bzhengs pa'i lha khang na/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i 'khyud yum zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa bris 'dug pa'ang rgyud dang mthun/ dgyes rdor gyi rigs tsho yang bkram gdan kho nar bzhengs 'dugadapal dus kyi 'khor lo dbus kyi cha la bzhugs pa sogs/ blo gros phur khung thug pa ma yin pa'i rnam 'gyur tshor 'dug pas/ phyis kyi 'ga' zhig la rgod bro ba cig kyang byung*/ de nas slar yang mkhar chen du phyin/ gshed dmar gyi dbang cig kyang byas/ tshe dbang sogs rkyen sel rnams kyang phul/ la stod lho phyogs kyi dgon grwa rigs rnams kyis yong dgos dgos tshul byung rung*/ slar bsam 'grub rtser gsangs brdol yongs khyab dang bstun nas dgongs rdzogs kyi mgo la 'gro dgos yong ba'i stabs/ yar phyogs 'gro ba bshol/ gsang sngags ri bo brgyu nas dge grod thub phyin/ rtag brtan chos 'phel gyi dgon pa 'debs pa'i sa chog dang bkod pa rnams kyang byas/ de rjes lcim lung gi byams gling du mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas bdag nyid kyi rnam thar nges par brjod pa'i rtogs brjod ces bya ba bzhugs/ - PAGE 90 -- PAGE 91 - - PAGE 1 -
